title: HarnessMM: Recursive Self-Improvement for Harness Token Efficiency
title_zh: HarnessMM：面向 Harness Token 效率的递归自我改进

paragraphs.en: Agent harnesses repeatedly invoke reasoning after tool feedback, even when an earlier call has already fixed the next action. We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency through guarded decision reuse and recursive self-improvement (RSI). RSI iteratively refines companion harness configurations from training feedback, with validation selecting the configuration for deployment. A controller at the model–tool boundary reuses resolved decisions to replace later reasoning callbacks while actor weights remain fixed. Executable Decision Graphs store exact actions, literal arguments, causal dependencies and public guards. Guarded Decision Reuse activates these persistent decisions from observed receipts; Certified Callback Substitution executes them through the native interface and records removal of the registered slow callback. New semantic decisions, unsupported evidence and selector abstention invoke the original actor again. The representation restricts what feedback may change, while complete-task measurements establish quality and cost. On HumanEval, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02 (29.54% saving). For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43% to 85.71% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62 (87.93% saving). A separate MBPP ablation measures 26.91% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52% lower cost than retained callbacks. These results establish guarded decision reuse as a practical way to reduce repeated reasoning in existing harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架在工具反馈后反复调用推理，即使更早的调用已经确定了下一步动作。 我们提出 HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minus），一种通过受保护决策复用与递归自我改进（RSI）来提升框架 token 效率的方法。 RSI 根据训练反馈迭代地精炼配套的框架配置，并通过验证选出用于部署的配置。 位于模型–工具边界的控制器复用已解析的决策来替代后续的推理回调，同时保持 actor 权重不变。 可执行决策图存储确切的动作、字面参数、因果依赖和公开守卫。 受保护决策复用根据观测到的回执激活这些持久化的决策；经认证的回调替换通过原生接口执行它们，并记录被注册的慢速回调的移除。 新的语义决策、不支持的证据和选择器弃权会再次调用原始 actor。 该表示限制了反馈可以改变的内容，而完整任务测量则确立质量与成本。 在 HumanEval 上，HarnessMM 将 Codex 的成功率保持在 90.82%，同时将 Tokens/task (k) 从 66.72 降至 47.02（节省 29.54%）。 对于 DeepSeek Harness，成功率从 71.43% 提升至 85.71%，同时 Tokens/task (k) 从 96.28 降至 11.62（节省 87.93%）。 一项独立的 MBPP 消融实验测得，其成本比单次使用图低 26.91%，比保留回调低 19.52%。 这些结果确立了受保护决策复用作为减少现有框架中重复推理的一种实用方法。

paragraphs.en: Agent harnesses connect model reasoning to tool execution. ReAct alternates reasoning, actions and observations [ 46 ] ; SWE-agent demonstrates that interface design shapes software-engineering performance [ 44 ] , and Toolformer learns when to call APIs [ 33 ] . After each tool result, the harness must decide whether the observation demands new reasoning or merely permits an already resolved action to execute. Repeated deliberation can regenerate decisions whose semantics have not changed.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体框架将模型推理与工具执行连接起来。 ReAct 在推理、行动与观察之间交替进行 [ 46 ]；SWE-agent 证明接口设计会影响软件工程性能 [ 44 ]，而 Toolformer 则学习何时调用 API [ 33 ]。 每次获得工具结果后，框架必须判断该观察结果是需要新的推理，还是仅仅允许一个已经确定的行动得以执行。 反复的推敲可能会重新生成语义并未改变的决策。

paragraphs.en: Efficiency methods intervene at different points. Prompt compression and history management reduce the input replayed into a call [ 16 , 17 , 30 , 42 , 21 ] . Fast–slow architectures and routing change who reasons and how deeply [ 4 , 45 , 27 ] . Executable skills, observation-independent plans and compiled tool dependencies reuse or schedule prior computation [ 40 , 43 , 19 ] . ActionEngine further executes task programs against reusable application memory with reactive repair [ 52 ] . These methods already establish the value of programmatic execution. HarnessMM studies a narrower contract: an episode-specific action remains literal, later feedback changes its eligibility, and the execution record identifies the reasoning boundary actually bypassed.
paragraphs.zh: 效率方法在不同环节进行干预。 提示压缩与历史管理减少重放到调用中的输入 [ 16 , 17 , 30 , 42 , 21 ] 。 快–慢架构与路由改变由谁推理以及推理的深度 [ 4 , 45 , 27 ] 。 可执行技能、独立于观察的计划以及编译后的工具依赖可以复用或调度先前的计算 [ 40 , 43 , 19 ] 。 ActionEngine 进一步针对可复用的应用记忆执行任务程序，并进行反应式修复 [ 52 ] 。 这些方法已经确立了程序化执行的价值。 HarnessMM 研究的是一个更窄的契约：特定回合的动作保持字面不变，后续反馈改变其可用性，而执行记录标识出实际被绕过的推理边界。

paragraphs.en: Feedback can optimize instructions and agent programs through APE, STOP, ADAS, Self-Refine and Reflexion [ 53 , 49 , 13 , 24 , 36 ] . Such optimization constructs a harness; its deployment still determines which callbacks recur. Jev’s typed probability interface [ 1 ] motivates compact candidate selection, but adding a selector does not remove the original callback automatically. We call this accounting mismatch the Substitution Paradox : computation is saved only when eliminated reasoning exceeds added authorship, selection and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: 反馈可以通过 APE、STOP、ADAS、Self-Refine 和 Reflexion [ 53 , 49 , 13 , 24 , 36 ] 来优化指令与智能体程序。 这类优化构建的是一个框架（harness）；其部署方式仍然决定哪些回调会反复出现。 Jev 的类型化概率接口 [ 1 ] 启发了紧凑的候选选择，但增加一个选择器并不会自动消除原有的回调。 我们将这种核算上的错位称为「替代悖论」：只有当被消除的推理量超过新增的编写、选择与恢复的工作量时，计算才会被真正节省。

sents.zh: 我们将这种核算上的错位称为「替代悖论」：只有当被消除的推理量超过新增的编写、选择与恢复的工作量时，计算才会被真正节省。

paragraphs.en: A concrete opportunity appears when slow reasoning fixes several actions before their execution feedback arrives. After writing a program, the next compilation command can already be specified; after compilation, a successful return code can activate an already-specified test command. We call a decision resolved when prior reasoning has fixed its action and literal arguments; the unknown tool receipt determines whether that action is ready to execute. The example separates semantic uncertainty from execution uncertainty and suggests a different role for feedback: activating a resolved decision. Our insight is that such decisions can persist across feedback boundaries as guarded executable commitments. An authored graph can serve multiple transitions while its continuations remain resolved; new inference returns control to the slow actor, which may reason and author further graphs throughout the task.
paragraphs.zh: 当缓慢推理在若干动作的执行反馈到来之前就将其确定时，一个具体的机会便出现了。 写完程序后，下一条编译命令就可以预先确定；编译完成后，成功的返回码可以激活一个已经预先确定的测试命令。 当先前的推理已经确定了某个决策的动作及其字面参数时，我们称该决策已被敲定；未知的工具回执决定了该动作是否已准备好执行。 该示例将语义不确定性从执行不确定性中分离出来，并暗示反馈可以扮演一种不同的角色：激活一个已敲定的决策。 我们的洞见是，这类决策可以作为受保护的可执行承诺跨越反馈边界持续存在。 一幅已撰写的图可以服务于多次转移，同时其后续动作保持已敲定状态；新的推理将控制权交还给缓慢的行动者，后者可以在整个任务过程中继续推理并撰写更多的图。

paragraphs.en: We introduce HarnessMM (Harness Minus Minus), a method for improving harness token efficiency by changing when the harness invokes its reasoning model (Figure 1 ). HarnessMM inserts a controller at the native decision boundary while keeping model weights, tools and task interfaces fixed. Executable Decision Graphs (EDGs) store actions and literal arguments already resolved by slow reasoning, together with their dependencies and public execution guards. Guarded Decision Reuse (GDR) retains these decisions across tool transitions and checks whether observed receipts satisfy their guards. Certified Callback Substitution (CCS) then dispatches the stored action through the native interface and omits the corresponding reasoning callback. A typed selector chooses an eligible decision or abstains; new semantic decisions, unsupported evidence and abstention return control to the original actor. This changes the harness’s execution policy so that resolved actions avoid repeated context input and reasoning output while unresolved decisions retain access to the original reasoning process. Complete-task accounting includes graph authorship, selection, remaining slow calls, fallback and unsuccessful executions. Recursive self-improvement (RSI) iteratively refines companion harness configurations: the current harness supplies training feedback for candidate edits, validation selects the retained candidate, and that harness supplies the next round’s training feedback. The selected configuration is frozen before test evaluation (Appendix B.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 HarnessMM（Harness Minus Minum，即“框架减一”），一种通过改变框架调用其推理模型的时机来提升框架 token 效率的方法（图 1）。 HarnessMM 在原生的决策边界处插入一个控制器，同时保持模型权重、工具和任务接口不变。 可执行决策图（EDG）存储已由慢速推理解析好的动作和字面量参数，连同它们的依赖关系和公开的执行守卫。 守卫式决策复用（GDR）在工具切换之间保留这些决策，并检查观测到的回执是否满足其守卫条件。 认证回调替换（CCS）随后通过原生接口分发已存储的动作，并省略相应的推理回调。 类型化选择器会选择一个符合条件的决策或选择放弃；新的语义决策、不受支持的证据以及放弃都会将控制权交还给原始执行者。 这改变了框架的执行策略，使得已解析的动作避免重复的上下文输入和推理输出，而未解析的决策仍可访问原始的推理过程。 完整任务核算包括图的创建、选择、剩余的慢速调用、回退以及失败的执行。 递归自我改进（RSI）迭代地优化伴随框架配置：当前框架为候选修改提供训练反馈，验证环节选出被保留的候选者，而该框架再为下一轮提供训练反馈。 所选配置在测试评估之前被冻结（附录 B.2）。

paragraphs.en: We integrate HarnessMM into Codex and DeepSeek Harness and evaluate each against its original harness. On the same 98 HumanEval test tasks, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02, a 29.54% saving. For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43% to 85.71% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62, an 87.93% saving (Section 5.3 ). These comparisons demonstrate that improving when a harness invokes reasoning and executes actions can reduce token consumption while preserving or improving task performance. An MBPP ablation isolates persistent decision reuse and callback removal, measuring 26.91% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52% lower cost than retained callbacks. Companion studies evaluate their benchmark-specific instruction and context configurations separately (Section 5.4 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 HarnessMM 集成到 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 中，并将其与各自原始 harness 进行对比评估。 在相同的 98 个 HumanEval 测试任务上，HarnessMM 将 Codex 的成功率保持在 90.82%，同时将 Tokens/task (k) 从 66.72 降至 47.02，节省了 29.54%。 对于 DeepSeek Harness，成功率从 71.43% 提升至 85.71%，同时 Tokens/task (k) 从 96.28 降至 11.62，节省了 87.93%（见第 5.3 节）。 这些对比表明，改进 harness 调用推理和执行动作的时机，可以在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时降低 token 消耗。 MBPP 消融实验隔离了持久化决策复用与回调移除两项机制，测得成本比单次使用图低 26.91%，比保留回调低 19.52%。 配套研究分别评估了它们针对基准的指令与上下文配置（见第 5.4 节）。

sents.en: We integrate HarnessMM into Codex and DeepSeek Harness and evaluate each against its original harness.
sents.zh: 我们将 HarnessMM 集成到 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 中，并将其与各自原始 harness 进行对比评估。

sents.en: On the same 98 HumanEval test tasks, HarnessMM preserves Codex success at 90.82% while reducing Tokens/task (k) from 66.72 to 47.02, a 29.54% saving.
sents.zh: 在相同的 98 个 HumanEval 测试任务上，HarnessMM 将 Codex 的成功率保持在 90.82%，同时将 Tokens/task (k) 从 66.72 降至 47.02，节省了 29.54%。

sents.en: For DeepSeek Harness, success rises from 71.43% to 85.71% while Tokens/task (k) fall from 96.28 to 11.62, an 87.93% saving (Section 5.3 ).
sents.zh: 对于 DeepSeek Harness，成功率从 71.43% 提升至 85.71%，同时 Tokens/task (k) 从 96.28 降至 11.62，节省了 87.93%（见第 5.3 节）。

sents.en: These comparisons demonstrate that improving when a harness invokes reasoning and executes actions can reduce token consumption while preserving or improving task performance.
sents.zh: 这些对比表明，改进 harness 调用推理和执行动作的时机，可以在保持甚至提升任务性能的同时降低 token 消耗。

sents.en: An MBPP ablation isolates persistent decision reuse and callback removal, measuring 26.91% lower cost than single-use graphs and 19.52% lower cost than retained callbacks.
sents.zh: MBPP 消融实验隔离了持久化决策复用与回调移除两项机制，测得成本比单次使用图低 26.91%，比保留回调低 19.52%。

sents.en: Companion studies evaluate their benchmark-specific instruction and context configurations separately (Section 5.4 ).
sents.zh: 配套研究分别评估了它们针对基准的指令与上下文配置（见第 5.4 节）。

paragraphs.en: EDGs separate resolved action semantics from feedback-dependent readiness, making prior deliberation executable at future tool boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: EDGs 将已解析的动作语义与依赖反馈的就绪状态分离，使先前的 deliberation（审慎规划）能够在未来的工具边界处变得可执行。

paragraphs.en: GDR retains the graph and uses public receipts to activate causally ordered actions while reserving new decisions for slow reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: GDR 保留图结构，并使用公开回执来激活因果有序的动作，同时将新的决策留给慢速推理。

paragraphs.en: CCS substitutes native execution for registered callbacks and verifies omission with receipt-bound certificates. The MBPP ablation measures how reuse and callback substitution affect success and complete task cost.
paragraphs.zh: CCS 用已注册回调的原生执行替代方式，并通过绑定回执的证书来验证省略情况。 MBPP 消融实验衡量复用与回调替代如何影响成功率与完整任务成本。

sents.en: CCS substitutes native execution for registered callbacks and verifies omission with receipt-bound certificates.
sents.zh: CCS 用已注册回调的原生执行替代方式，并通过绑定回执的证书来验证省略情况。

sents.en: The MBPP ablation measures how reuse and callback substitution affect success and complete task cost.
sents.zh: MBPP 消融实验衡量复用与回调替代如何影响成功率与完整任务成本。

paragraphs.en: LLMLingua and its successors compress prompt inputs [ 16 , 17 , 30 ] ; AgentDiet and observation masking reduce replayed trajectory context [ 42 , 21 ] . Thinking budgets control generated reasoning [ 15 ] . These methods reduce the size or depth of a call; HarnessMM targets whether that call needs to recur at all.
paragraphs.zh: LLMLingua 及其后续工作压缩提示词输入 [ 16 , 17 , 30 ] ；AgentDiet 和观察掩码减少回放轨迹的上下文 [ 42 , 21 ] 。 思考预算控制生成的推理 [ 15 ] 。 这些方法减少调用的规模或深度；HarnessMM 针对的则是该调用是否根本需要重复发生。

sents.en: LLMLingua and its successors compress prompt inputs [ 16 , 17 , 30 ] ; AgentDiet and observation masking reduce replayed trajectory context [ 42 , 21 ] .
sents.zh: LLMLingua 及其后续工作压缩提示词输入 [ 16 , 17 , 30 ] ；AgentDiet 和观察掩码减少回放轨迹的上下文 [ 42 , 21 ] 。

sents.en: Thinking budgets control generated reasoning [ 15 ] .
sents.zh: 思考预算控制生成的推理 [ 15 ] 。

sents.en: These methods reduce the size or depth of a call; HarnessMM targets whether that call needs to recur at all.
sents.zh: 这些方法减少调用的规模或深度；HarnessMM 针对的则是该调用是否根本需要重复发生。

paragraphs.en: Talker–Reasoner separates response and planning [ 4 ] ; CogRouter adapts cognitive depth [ 45 ] ; boundary-guided routing chooses the reasoning model [ 50 ] . Jev motivates typed compact decisions [ 1 ] . Our Jev-motivated typed selector uses a candidate-ID/abstention interface, with single-token decoding when selection requires a model call. HarnessMM studies whether such a compact decision actually removes a future reasoning callback.
paragraphs.zh: Talker–Reasoner 将响应与规划分离 [4]；CogRouter 适配认知深度 [45]；边界引导的路由选择推理模型 [50]。 Jev 促成了类型化紧凑决策的动机 [1]。 我们受 Jev 启发的类型化选择器采用候选 ID/弃权接口，当选择需要调用模型时使用单 token 解码。 HarnessMM 研究这类紧凑决策是否真的能消除未来的推理回调。

sents.en: Talker–Reasoner separates response and planning [ 4 ] ; CogRouter adapts cognitive depth [ 45 ] ; boundary-guided routing chooses the reasoning model [ 50 ] .
sents.zh: Talker–Reasoner 将响应与规划分离 [4]；CogRouter 适配认知深度 [45]；边界引导的路由选择推理模型 [50]。

sents.en: Jev motivates typed compact decisions [ 1 ] .
sents.zh: Jev 促成了类型化紧凑决策的动机 [1]。

sents.en: Our Jev-motivated typed selector uses a candidate-ID/abstention interface, with single-token decoding when selection requires a model call.
sents.zh: 我们受 Jev 启发的类型化选择器采用候选 ID/弃权接口，当选择需要调用模型时使用单 token 解码。

sents.en: HarnessMM studies whether such a compact decision actually removes a future reasoning callback.
sents.zh: HarnessMM 研究这类紧凑决策是否真的能消除未来的推理回调。

paragraphs.en: Chain-of-thought prompting exposes intermediate reasoning [ 41 ] , Voyager retains executable skills [ 40 ] , and SkillLens retrieves procedural context [ 25 ] . A skill or macro can inform future reasoning or encapsulate a routine. An EDG instead stores episode-specific, fully resolved semantic commitments; public execution conditions control their activation. This distinction allows execution to replace a reasoning call rather than merely guide it.
paragraphs.zh: 思维链提示暴露中间推理过程 [ 41 ]，Voyager 保留可执行的技能 [ 40 ]，而 SkillLens 检索程序性上下文 [ 25 ]。 技能或宏可以为未来的推理提供信息，或者封装一个例行流程。 EDG 则存储特定于情节的、完全解析的语义承诺；公开的执行条件控制它们的激活。 这一区别使执行能够取代一次推理调用，而不仅仅是引导它。

paragraphs.en: APE, STOP and ADAS improve prompts, programs and agent configurations from feedback [ 53 , 49 , 13 ] . Self-modification methods extend the search to improvement operators [ 47 , 51 , 38 ] . HarnessMM changes when a harness calls its reasoning model and when it directly executes a previously resolved action. Instruction optimization, context compaction and RSI supply companion configurations; they are outside the core execution method and retain separate experimental attribution. Their development protocols and costs appear in Appendix B.2 .

paragraphs.en: HarnessMM changes the route from tool feedback to the next native action. EDG stores resolved decisions, GDR determines their eligibility, and CCS substitutes native execution for registered slow callbacks. The controller integrates with an existing harness through its public-state adapter, slow-call entry point and native action dispatcher.
paragraphs.zh: HarnessMM 将路由从工具反馈改为下一个原生动作。 EDG 存储已解析的决策，GDR 判定其是否适用，CCS 用原生执行替代已注册的慢回调。 该控制器通过其公开状态适配器、慢调用入口点和原生动作分发器与现有的 harness 集成。

sents.en: HarnessMM changes the route from tool feedback to the next native action.
sents.zh: HarnessMM 将路由从工具反馈改为下一个原生动作。

sents.en: EDG stores resolved decisions, GDR determines their eligibility, and CCS substitutes native execution for registered slow callbacks.
sents.zh: EDG 存储已解析的决策，GDR 判定其是否适用，CCS 用原生执行替代已注册的慢回调。

sents.en: The controller integrates with an existing harness through its public-state adapter, slow-call entry point and native action dispatcher.

paragraphs.en: The core method decides whether a stored action can replace the next reasoning call. Prompt editing, context compaction and finalization rules configure the surrounding harness. They are developed on training data, selected before evaluation and held fixed during each run. The runtime selector chooses an eligible EDG node or abstains; it does not choose which optimization techniques to combine. Appendix D.5 maps each reported configuration to its actual intervention.
paragraphs.zh: 核心方法决定一个已存储的动作能否替代下一次推理调用。 提示词编辑、上下文压缩与终结规则对周边的运行框架进行配置。 它们在训练数据上开发，在评估前选定，并在每次运行期间保持不变。 运行时选择器挑选一个符合条件的 EDG 节点或选择弃权；它并不决定组合哪些优化技术。 附录 D.5 将每个报告的配置映射到其实际的干预手段。

paragraphs.en: An EDG stores actions whose semantics and arguments slow reasoning has already resolved. For example, a coding actor can fix a file-write action, a make command and a pytest command. Public guards determine whether these stored actions can execute; later receipts supply readiness evidence without regenerating their arguments.

paragraphs.en: The input EDG in Figure 1 combines reasoning, context compaction, fast decisions and tool use. For the coding example, guards can check a missing file, available build inputs or a successful build. Dependencies must also be complete. Edges connect the root or an earlier node to a successor, forming an acyclic graph. Missing or rejecting receipts prevent admission; an empty graph returns control to the slow actor.
paragraphs.zh: 图1中的输入事件驱动图结合了推理、上下文压缩、快速决策和工具使用。 在编码示例中，守卫可以检查缺失的文件、可用的构建输入或成功的构建。 依赖项也必须是完整的。 边将根节点或较早的节点连接到后继节点，形成一个无环图。 缺失或拒绝回执会阻止准入；空图则将控制权交还给慢速执行体。

paragraphs.en: Training develops author prompts, context settings and adapter rules. Disjoint validation selects among training-frozen configurations; the selected implementation is frozen before testing. These offline choices set the inputs and action contract of the execution controller. They remain distinct from its online choice between an eligible stored action and slow reasoning. Appendix B.2 gives the development protocols. Appendix D specifies the execution algorithm, assumptions and structural invariants.
paragraphs.zh: 训练过程用于制定作者提示词、上下文设置与适配器规则。 不相交的验证集在训练时冻结的配置中进行选择；所选实现在测试之前被冻结。 这些离线选择设定了执行控制器的输入与动作契约。 它们与该控制器在符合条件的已存储动作和缓慢推理之间的在线选择保持区分。 附录 B.2 给出了开发协议。 附录 D 规定了执行算法、假设与结构不变量。

paragraphs.en: All methods use the same tasks, backbone, original tools, task limits and scorer. All compared methods, including baselines and native harnesses, receive token-efficiency prompts and an explicit objective to reduce complete-task input-plus-output token consumption while preserving task performance. Success uses the benchmark evaluation endpoint, and token cost includes input plus output for all paid calls, including failures. Development optimization cost is reported separately from complete-task execution. Full-population coding comparisons use custom 20/20/60 splits: HumanEval 33/33/98 and MBPP 85/85/257, with deterministic rounding and fixed task IDs. TRAIN supplies revisions, validation selects TRAIN-frozen candidates, and TEST measures the selected configuration. The coding ablations evaluate the core execution method; native harness pairs evaluate its integration with fixed context and finalization settings. Figure 2 retains the companion studies. Appendix D.5 identifies their differing mechanisms, populations and cost scope.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法均使用相同的任务、骨干模型、原始工具、任务限制和评分器。 所有被比较的方法，包括基线方法和原生套件，均接收令牌效率提示词以及一个明确的目标：在保持任务性能的同时，减少完成任务的输入加输出令牌消耗。 成功率使用基准评测端点计算，令牌成本包括所有付费调用的输入加输出，包括失败的调用。 开发优化成本与完成任务的执行成本分开报告。 全总体编程比较使用自定义的 20/20/60 划分：HumanEval 为 33/33/98，MBPP 为 85/85/257，采用确定性舍入和固定任务 ID。 TRAIN 提供修订，validation 从 TRAIN 冻结的候选中选择，TEST 衡量被选中的配置。 编程消融实验评估核心执行方法；原生套件配对则评估其与固定上下文和收尾设置的集成。 图 2 保留了配套研究。 附录 D.5 指出了它们在机制、总体和成本范围上的差异。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 reports model-call and substitution statistics on 98 HumanEval and 257 MBPP-sanitized test tasks. On HumanEval, the DeepSeek Harness falls from 954 to 415 paid model calls, with 147 certified callback bypasses (1.50/task); Codex falls from 524 to 499 calls, with 18 certified bypasses (0.18/task). On MBPP-sanitized, DeepSeek Harness falls from 1,633 to 1,088 calls, with 472 certified bypasses (1.84/task), while success rises from 90.27% to 91.83%. The MBPP-sanitized Codex pair records 91.83% and 90.66% success at 129.55 and 49.22 Tokens/task (k) (Appendix L.1 ). The original harnesses have zero certified bypasses. All rates use the full task set for each method.
paragraphs.zh: 表1报告了在98个HumanEval和257个MBPP-sanitized测试任务上的模型调用与替换统计。 在HumanEval上，DeepSeek Harness的付费模型调用从954次降至415次，含147次经认证的回调绕过（每任务1.50次）；Codex的调用从524次降至499次，含18次经认证的绕过（每任务0.18次）。 在MBPP-sanitized上，DeepSeek Harness的调用从1,633次降至1,088次，含472次经认证的绕过（每任务1.84次），同时成功率从90.27%升至91.83%。 MBPP-sanitized上的Codex成对记录了91.83%和90.66%的成功率，Tokens/task (k)分别为129.55和49.22（附录L.1）。 原始Harness的经认证绕过次数为零。 所有比率均使用每个方法的完整任务集。

paragraphs.en: We use the official Codex and DeepSeek Harness runtimes [ 28 , 5 ] , with the same pinned backbone, original interface and scorer within each pair. HumanEval supplies a complete held-out comparison: Codex preserves 90.82% success with 66.72 versus 47.02 Tokens/task (k) (29.54% saving); DeepSeek Harness improves from 71.43% to 85.71% with 96.28 versus 11.62 Tokens/task (k) (87.93% saving). Paired outcomes show five improvements and five regressions for Codex; DeepSeek Harness has 22 improvements and eight regressions (two-sided exact McNemar p = 0.0161 p=0.0161 ). These integrated harness effects combine literal-bank reuse, context management and finalization. Their total call-count difference is therefore not an isolated effect of certificates; the MBPP ablations below isolate persistence and callback retention. The MiMo-v2.6-pro DeepSeek Harness comparison completes the same 98-task population: baseline success is 96.94% and HarnessMM success is 97.96%, with 11.62 versus 4.40 Tokens/task (k) (62.12% saving). Figure 3 (e) reports this MiMo pair separately from the Qwen comparisons; the MiMo Codex pair completes the same 98-task evaluation at 93.88% versus 94.90% success. Its costs are 62.60 versus 10.09 Tokens/task (k); MiMo MBPP Codex completes the same 257-task evaluation at 96.50% versus 97.28% success, with 47.56 versus 11.00 Tokens/task (k); the MiMo DeepSeek Harness pair completes the same 257-task population at 97.67% versus 98.05% success, with 6.20 versus 5.11 Tokens/task (k). Slow reasoning authors literal action banks, and CPU receipt guards execute 480 native substitutions (Appendix L.1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用官方的 Codex 和 DeepSeek Harness 运行时 [28, 5]，在每对配置中保持相同的固定骨干模型、原始接口和评分器。 HumanEval 提供了完整的保留集对比：Codex 保持 90.82% 的成功率，Tokens/task (k) 从 47.02 降至 66.72 中的 66.72 对 47.02（节省 29.54%）；DeepSeek Harness 将成功率从 71.43% 提升至 85.71%，Tokens/task (k) 为 96.28 对 11.62（节省 87.93%）。 成对结果显示 Codex 有五项改进和五项退化；DeepSeek Harness 有 22 项改进和八项退化（双侧精确 McNemar p = 0.0161 p=0.0161）。 这些集成的 harness 效应结合了字面库复用、上下文管理和收尾处理。 因此，它们总调用次数的差异并非证书的孤立效应；下文的 MBPP 消融实验将分离持久化和回调保留的影响。 MiMo-v2.6-pro 的 DeepSeek Harness 对比完成了同样的 98 任务群体：基线成功率为 96.94%，HarnessMM 成功率为 97.96%，Tokens/task (k) 为 11.62 对 4.40（节省 62.12%）。 图 3 (e) 将这组 MiMo 对比与 Qwen 对比分开报告；MiMo Codex 对完成了同样的 98 任务评估，成功率为 93.88% 对 94.90%。 其成本为 62.60 对 10.09 Tokens/task (k)；MiMo MBPP Codex 完成了同样的 257 任务评估，成功率为 96.50% 对 97.28%，Tokens/task (k) 为 47.56 对 11.00；MiMo DeepSeek Harness 对完成了同样的 257 任务群体，成功率为 97.67% 对 98.05%，Tokens/task (k) 为 6.20 对 5.11。 慢推理负责撰写字面动作库，CPU 回执守卫执行 480 次原生替换（附录 L.1）。

paragraphs.en: Figure 2 presents ALFWorld, SearchQA, LiveMath, AIME, Terminal-Bench 2 and GAIA2 in their original order, with No Skill, SkillOpt, AutoSaddler and HarnessMM in each panel. The HarnessMM label identifies each study’s selected configuration. paragraphs.en: On complete SearchQA validation, HarnessMM reaches 76.76% EM at 0.99 Tokens/task (k), saving 19.08% against No Skill (paired 95% interval [ 16.57 , 21.23 ] [16.57,21.23] %), 38.57% against SkillOpt and 20.75% against AutoSaddler (Table 21 ). On all 560 AIME test questions, HarnessMM reaches 87.14% accuracy, compared with 86.96% for No Skill, 87.86% for SkillOpt and 88.04% for AutoSaddler. HarnessMM uses 5.90 Tokens/task (k), including shared authorship: 14.94% below SkillOpt, 28.34% above No Skill and 20.44% above AutoSaddler. The cost decomposition in Table 15 shows 0.54 input, 4.28 output and 1.08 shared-author Tokens/task (k). No Skill uses 0.22 input and 4.38 output Tokens/task (k): generated reasoning dominates this mathematical workload. The small reduction in HarnessMM’s execution output is outweighed by its additional input and authorship. The comparison uses one execution per question under the same frozen model and native scoring protocol. SkillOpt uses three completed training rounds; AutoSaddler retains its completed four-round policy. The separate original 18-question AIME 2025 comparison remains in Appendix I.1 . On all 480 GAIA2 test scenarios, HarnessMM reaches 43.96% success with 639.64 Tokens/task (k), compared with 42.71% and 730.22 for No Skill, 46.88% and 770.63 for SkillOpt, and 42.08% and 772.22 for AutoSaddler. HarnessMM reduces complete actor cost by 12.41%, 17.00% and 17.17%, respectively. The integrated harness performs 146 verified fast native executions (1.40% of all action attempts); input accounts for 99.47% of its actor cost (Table 16 ). It gains 1.25 percentage points over No Skill while remaining 2.92 points below SkillOpt. Each scenario runs once per method after frozen validation selection; all unsuccessful executions remain in the quality and cost aggregates. Appendix I reports a separate quality–cost study of development candidates and frozen GAIA2 validation results.
paragraphs.zh: 在完整的 SearchQA 验证集上，HarnessMM 达到 76.76% 的 EM，成本为 0.99 Tokens/task (k)，相比 No Skill 节省 19.08%（配对 95% 区间 [16.57, 21.23]%），相比 SkillOpt 节省 38.57%，相比 AutoSaddler 节省 20.75%（表 21）。 在全部 560 道 AIME 测试题上，HarnessMM 达到 87.14% 的准确率，相比之下 No Skill 为 86.96%，SkillOpt 为 87.86%，AutoSaddler 为 88.04%。 HarnessMM 使用 5.90 Tokens/task (k)，含共享 authorship：比 SkillOpt 低 14.94%，比 No Skill 高 28.34%，比 AutoSaddler 高 20.44%。 表 15 中的成本分解显示，每任务（k）为 0.54 输入、4.28 输出和 1.08 共享 authorship Tokens/task (k)。 No Skill 使用 0.22 输入和 4.38 输出 Tokens/task (k)：生成的推理过程主导了这一数学工作负载。 HarnessMM 执行输出的少量减少被其额外的输入和 authorship 成本所抵消。 该比较在同一冻结模型和原生评分协议下，每个问题执行一次。 SkillOpt 使用了三个已完成的训练轮次；AutoSaddler 保留其已完成的四轮策略。 单独的原始 18 题 AIME 2025 比较仍保留在附录 I.1 中。 在全部 480 个 GAIA2 测试场景上，HarnessMM 达到 43.96% 的成功率，成本为 639.64 Tokens/task (k)，相比之下 No Skill 为 42.71% 和 730.22，SkillOpt 为 46.88% 和 770.63，AutoSaddler 为 42.08% 和 772.22。 HarnessMM 分别将完整 actor 成本降低 12.41%、17.00% 和 17.17%。 集成 harness 执行了 146 次经过验证的快速原生执行（占所有动作尝试的 1.40%）；输入占其 actor 成本的 99.47%（表 16）。 它比 No Skill 高出 1.25 个百分点，同时仍比 SkillOpt 低 2.92 个百分点。 每个场景在冻结验证选择后，每种方法运行一次；所有未成功的执行仍保留在质量与成本统计中。 附录 I 报告了对开发候选方案和冻结的 GAIA2 验证结果的单独质量–成本研究。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 compares six frozen instruction conditions on the same 2,133 tasks across seeds 9401, 9402 and 9403. HarnessMM averages 65.70% success at 31.44 Tokens/task (k). paragraphs.en: Our second ablation isolates GDR and CCS on MBPP-sanitized [ 2 ] with DeepSeek Harness and a fixed backbone. Figure 4 compares four conditions on the same 257 tasks. Full HarnessMM reaches 93.77% success at 13.17 Tokens/task (k), versus 93.00% and 18.03 for W/o GDR (single-use EDG). GDR reduces complete cost by 26.91%, with a task-paired adjusted interval of [4.01, 45.57]%.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的第二项消融实验在 MBPP-sanitized [2] 上、使用 DeepSeek Harness 和固定骨干网络，单独隔离 GDR 和 CCS。 图 4 在相同的 257 个任务上比较了四种条件。 完整的 HarnessMM 达到 93.77% 的成功率、13.17 Tokens/task (k)，而 W/o GDR（单次使用的 EDG）为 93.00% 和 18.03。 GDR 将完整成本降低了 26.91%，任务配对的调整区间为 [4.01, 45.57]%。

paragraphs.en: Full HarnessMM makes 407 certified substitutions, including repeated bypasses in 201 graphs. W/o CCS (callbacks retained) reaches 93.39% at 16.37 Tokens/task (k), a measured 19.52% cost reduction for full HarnessMM. Disabling EDG execution reaches 95.33% at 16.19: full HarnessMM uses 18.62% fewer tokens but solves four fewer tasks. Certificates verify removal; their independent benefit is not ablated. Appendix E gives the shared execution settings, paired uncertainty and historical comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 HarnessMM 进行了 407 次经认证的替换，其中包括在 201 个图中的重复绕过。 无 CCS（保留回调）在 16.37 Tokens/task (k) 下达到 93.39%，为完整 HarnessMM 实测降低了 19.52% 的成本。 禁用 EDG 执行在 16.19 下达到 95.33%：完整 HarnessMM 使用的 token 减少 18.62%，但少解决了四个任务。 证书用于验证移除；其独立收益并未进行消融。 附录 E 给出了共享的执行设置、成对不确定性与历史比较。

paragraphs.en: The complete coding comparisons measure integrated harness quality and cost. The single-use and retained-callback ablations directly test persistent reuse and callback removal. Instruction-only ALFWorld measures instruction content. Certificates establish execution and omission, while native scoring establishes quality; no per-certificate token value is assumed.
paragraphs.zh: 完整编码对比衡量的是集成的评测框架质量与成本。 单次使用与保留回调的消融实验直接检验持久复用与回调移除。 仅指令的 ALFWorld 衡量指令内容。 证书确立执行与遗漏，而原生评分确立质量；不假设每个证书的 token 价值。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 shows eight training-guided harness RSI iterations on the same 32 MiniWoB++ training tasks. Each pair shares the actor, author prompt, full screenshots, coordinate compiler, guards, fallback, native scorer and limits; single-use EDGs permit one future execution per graph, while HarnessMM retains eligible decisions. Training feedback refines visual grounding and screenshot context. Disjoint validation selects a frozen configuration before testing.
paragraphs.zh: 图 5 展示了在相同的 32 个 MiniWoB++ 训练任务上进行的八次训练引导式 harness RSI 迭代。 每一对都共享执行器、author 提示词、完整截图、坐标编译器、守护机制、回退机制、原生评分器和限制；单次使用的 EDG 允许每个图执行一次未来操作，而 HarnessMM 则保留符合条件的决策。 训练反馈用于改进视觉定位与截图上下文。 在测试之前，通过互斥的验证集选定一个冻结的配置。

paragraphs.en: Across the first eight iterations, HarnessMM success rises from 34.38% to 90.63%, while Tokens/task (k) fall from 3.26 to 1.06 (67.43%). At the eighth iteration, both arms solve 29 of 32 tasks; persistence saves 29.83% (1.51 versus 1.06 Tokens/task (k); paired task-bootstrap 95% interval [ 18.84 , 39.00 ] % [18.84,39.00]\% ). Calls/task fall from 1.47 to 1.03, with 16 second-and-later executions within retained graphs.

paragraphs.en: HarnessMM improves harness token efficiency by storing resolved decisions, checking when they can execute and using them to replace repeated reasoning calls. Complete HumanEval comparisons on all 98 test tasks preserve Codex success at 90.82% with 29.54% fewer actor tokens and improve DeepSeek Harness from 71.43% to 85.71% with 87.93% fewer tokens. The MBPP ablation isolates persistence and callback removal; companion studies retain their own configuration scope.
paragraphs.zh: HarnessMM 通过存储已确定的决策、检查它们何时可以执行，并利用它们替换重复的推理调用，从而提高 harness 的 token 效率。 在全部 98 个测试任务上完成的 HumanEval 对比中，Codex 成功率保持在 90.82%，同时 actor token 减少 29.54%；DeepSeek Harness 成功率从 71.43% 提升到 85.71%，同时 token 减少 87.93%。 MBPP 消融实验隔离了持久化与回调移除的影响；配套研究则保留其各自的配置范围。

paragraphs.en: The eight MiniWoB++ harness RSI iterations in Figure 5 evaluate HarnessMM. Every RSI iteration evaluates all 32 training tasks once per arm, with identical task instances and actor seed. The actor is Qwen3.5-9B; inputs are full screenshots, the action limit is 15 and the episode allowance is 180 seconds. Single-use EDG permits one future execution per authored graph. HarnessMM retains eligible nodes across later tool-feedback boundaries. Both arms share the iteration-specific author prompt, public screenshot context, coordinate compiler, visual guards and fallback. These shared components develop across chronological RSI iterations. The curve measures training-guided harness RSI; it is not a series of autonomous optimizer rounds or held-out test evaluations.
paragraphs.zh: 图5中的八次MiniWoB++基座RSI迭代评估的是HarnessMM。 每次RSI迭代对全部32个训练任务按每个分支评估一次，任务实例与actor种子完全相同。 actor是Qwen3.5-9B；输入为完整截图，动作上限为15步，回合时限为180秒。 单次使用的EDG允许每张已编写的图执行一次未来执行。 HarnessMM在后续的工具反馈边界之间保留符合条件的节点。 两个分支共享特定于迭代的编写提示词、公开截图上下文、坐标编译器、视觉防护与回退机制。 这些共享组件随时间顺序的RSI迭代逐步演进。 该曲线衡量的是训练引导的基座RSI；它并非一系列自主优化轮次或保留测试集上的评估。

paragraphs.en: Tokens/task (k) equals complete actor input-plus-output tokens divided by 32 and 1,000. Calls/task counts every measured physical model request, including authorship, native reasoning, retained callbacks and paid fallbacks, divided by all 32 tasks. Every episode’s authorship, native reasoning, control, fallback and unsuccessful requests is charged. Optimization, candidate selection, validation and historical research costs are outside these per-iteration execution measurements and remain in the separate complete ledgers. Accordingly, the curve measures candidate execution efficiency. The paired interval at the eighth RSI iteration resamples tasks within the same fixed task set; there is one execution per task and arm.
paragraphs.zh: 每任务 Token 数（千）等于完整的 actor 输入加输出 Token 总数除以 32 再除以 1,000。 每任务调用次数统计每次被测量的物理模型请求，包括创作、原生推理、保留的回调以及付费回退，再除以全部 32 个任务。 每个回合（episode）的创作、原生推理、控制、回退以及失败请求均计入费用。 优化、候选选择、验证以及历史研究的成本不包含在这些每轮迭代执行测量之中，仍保留在单独的完整账目里。 因此，该曲线衡量的是候选执行效率。 第 8 次 RSI 迭代处的成对区间在同一固定任务集内对任务进行重采样；每个任务和每个分支（arm）各执行一次。

paragraphs.en: At round k k , the QA harness stores profiles h D , k h_{\mathrm{D},k} (DELETE) and h M , k h_{\mathrm{M},k} (MODIFY). Initially, MODIFY adds five answer-normalization rules to DELETE; the remaining four sections and answer contract are identical. A frozen linear head selects MODIFY when g ⁡ ( x ) ≥ κ g(x)\geq\kappa , and DELETE otherwise. Its eight input-only features are context token count, document count, question character and token counts, question–context lexical coverage, quoted-span and relation-cue indicators, and named-token count. The archived threshold maximizes discovery exact matches using five-fold out-of-fold predictions, subject to at least 8% token saving and at most 5% harm relative to SkillOpt. Deployment reads frozen h D , K h_{\mathrm{D},K} and h M , K h_{\mathrm{M},K} without a router-model call, generated answers or reference labels. Interactive tasks instead use their task-family instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 k k 轮，QA 测试框架存储配置 h D , k h_{\mathrm{D},k} （DELETE）和 h M , k h_{\mathrm{M},k} （MODIFY）。 初始时，MODIFY 在 DELETE 的基础上添加五条答案规范化规则；其余四个部分和答案契约完全相同。 冻结的线性头在 g ⁡ ( x ) ≥ κ g(x)\geq\kappa 时选择 MODIFY，否则选择 DELETE。 它的八个仅输入特征是：上下文 token 数、文档数、问题的字符数和 token 数、问题与上下文的词汇覆盖率、引文片段和关系线索指示符，以及命名 token 数。 归档的阈值在满足相对 SkillOpt 至少节省 8% token 且至多造成 5% 性能损害的约束下，通过五折折外预测最大化发现精确匹配数。 部署时直接读取冻结的 h D , K h_{\mathrm{D},K} 和 h M , K h_{\mathrm{M},K} ，无需路由模型调用、生成答案或参考标签。 交互式任务则使用其所属任务族的指令。

paragraphs.en: The full-source QA adapter retrieves original rule sentences from the selected profile, retaining normalization and answer-format rules. It supplies these sentences and the complete context to a draft call with a 512-token output cap. Format, source-location and explicit answer-type checks either accept the draft unchanged or restore the complete selected profile in a second actor call. Explicit negative/comparison questions and multiple blanks bypass the draft. All draft and fallback tokens are charged. Earlier compact-context and model-selected variants have separate identities (Appendix J ).
paragraphs.zh: 全源问答适配器从所选配置中检索原始规则句子，保留规范化与答案格式规则。 它将这些句子和完整上下文提供给一次输出上限为 512 个 token 的草稿调用。 格式、来源位置和显式答案类型检查要么原样接受草稿，要么在第二次智能体调用中恢复完整的所选配置。 显式的否定/比较问题和多个空格会绕过草稿。 所有草稿与回退 token 均被计费。 早期的紧凑上下文与模型选择变体具有各自独立的身份（附录 J）。

paragraphs.en: The historical textual pilot uses the original routed QA adapter and 32/32/32/128 source-group-disjoint tasks for training, inner validation, meta validation and the final screen. This four-role protocol predates the custom 20/20/60 comparisons. Training feedback contains responses, official scores, token usage and successful cases to preserve. A fixed compiler applies proposed edits to named rule slots after checking the parent hash, schema, permitted fields and size constraints. It rejects executable code, answer literals and case-specific facts. Retained rules and answer contracts keep their source bytes; invalid proposals alias the parent and remain charged.
paragraphs.zh: 历史文本试点使用原始的路由式问答适配器，并采用 32/32/32/128 个源组不相交的任务分别用于训练、内部验证、元验证和最终筛选。 这个四角色协议早于自定义的 20/20/60 对比实验。 训练反馈包含回复内容、官方评分、令牌使用量以及需要保留的成功案例。 固定编译器在检查父哈希、模式、允许字段和大小约束后，将提出的修改应用到指定的规则槽位。 它会拒绝可执行代码、答案字面量和特定案例的事实。 保留的规则和答案契约保持其原始字节；无效的提案会以别名方式引用父节点并保持计费状态。

paragraphs.en: A child passes the harness gate only if it changes the harness, preserves the parent’s EM and F1 on both validation splits, uses at most 90% of Original’s inference tokens on both, and improves at least one quality or cost endpoint over the parent. Fixed-policy RSI ranks passing children by meta-validation EM, then F1, then lower cost. Rejection retains the parent; the next round obtains fresh training feedback from the retained harness. Actor weights, routing, execution code, task interfaces, scorers and output caps stay fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 仅当满足以下条件时，子代才能通过脚手架门控：它改变了脚手架，在两个验证集划分上均保持父代的 EM 和 F1，在两个划分上使用的推理 token 均不超过 Original 的 90%，并且至少在一个质量或成本端点上优于父代。 固定策略的 RSI 按元验证 EM、其次 F1、再次更低成本对通过门控的子代进行排序。 若被拒绝，则保留父代；下一轮从保留的脚手架获取新的训练反馈。 智能体权重、路由、执行代码、任务接口、评分器和输出上限均保持固定。

paragraphs.en: The restricted MetaRSI branch [ 38 ] also proposes a strategy π ~ k \widetilde{\pi}_{k} from training feedback. Old and new strategies receive the same parent and feedback and produce separate children. Joint acceptance requires a changed strategy and a distinct child that passes the harness gate, matches or exceeds the old-strategy child’s EM and F1 at no greater cost on each validation split, and improves at least one endpoint strictly on meta validation. Rejection retains ( h k , π k ) (h_{k},\pi_{k}) , including any previously accepted strategy change; ordinary RSI keeps π k = π 0 \pi_{k}=\pi_{0} . Protected validation examples and answers never enter proposal prompts. Frozen final releases must improve EM and F1 over both Original and fixed-policy RSI, save at least 10% of Original’s inference tokens, and use no more tokens than fixed-policy RSI. These final-screen requirements are separate from round acceptance.

paragraphs.en: GDR reuses the authored graph across tool transitions, while CCS executes admitted actions in place of slow callbacks and certifies their removal. The EDG notation names the executable conditional graph represented by the coding adapter’s serialized action bank. Bank hashes identify the serialized graph in the archived audit. The native adapter checks predecessor completion, literal arguments and observed public guards before executing a node. Receipt errors, nonzero return codes, missing dependencies and unknown or false guards return control to slow reasoning. A unique eligible node takes a deterministic path with zero selector tokens. Frozen adapter settings and source identities remain in the external reproduction artifacts. The complete actor ledger includes authorship, selection, fallback and recovery.
paragraphs.zh: GDR 在工具切换之间复用已编写的图，而 CCS 就地执行已准入的动作以替代缓慢的回调，并认证它们的移除。 EDG 记法命名由编码适配器的序列化动作库所表示的可执行条件图。 库哈希在归档的审计中标识序列化的图。 原生适配器在执行节点之前检查前驱完成情况、字面量参数以及观测到的公共守卫。 回执错误、非零返回码、缺失依赖以及未知或为假的守卫会将控制权交还给缓慢推理。 唯一的合格节点会走一条确定性的路径，且不消耗任何选择器令牌。 冻结的适配器设置与源标识保留在外部复现工件中。 完整的执行者账本包括编写、选择、回退与恢复。

paragraphs.en: The complete MBPP training set (85 tasks) SDK comparison records 153 certified substitutions and 62 public-guard confirmations, with all physical actor costs reconciled. Its policy is the historical structured literal-bank v23 candidate. The complete selected MBPP test set (257 tasks) comparison in Appendix L evaluates the separately frozen v66 candidate. The Codex compound-bank v10 candidate records three certified substitutions but does not pass the broader adoption gate. The training attribution audit appears in Appendix F.3 . The historical companion-policy vocabulary includes DELETE, BYPASS, SUBSTITUTE, COMPACT, CACHE/REUSE, TERMINATE and COLLAPSE. It describes the surrounding configuration search, rather than additional modules of the EDG/GDR/CCS execution method. Recovery and finalization rules retain their declared per-run settings.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 MBPP 训练集（85 个任务）的 SDK 对比记录了 153 个经认证的替换和 62 个公共防护确认，所有物理行动者成本均已对账。 其策略是历史结构化字面库 v23 候选。 附录 L 中完整选定 MBPP 测试集（257 个任务）的对比评估了单独冻结的 v66 候选。 Codex 复合库 v10 候选记录了三个经认证的替换，但未通过更广泛的采用门槛。 训练归因审计见附录 F.3。 历史伴随策略词汇表包括 DELETE、BYPASS、SUBSTITUTE、COMPACT、CACHE/REUSE、TERMINATE 和 COLLAPSE。 它描述的是周边的配置搜索，而非 EDG/GDR/CCS 执行方法的额外模块。 恢复与终结规则保留其声明的每次运行设置。

paragraphs.en: A decision has a type and a payload. We write an action decision as Act ⁡ ( a ) \operatorname{Act}(a) : it executes a tool command and, if the task continues, receives feedback for the next decision. A terminal decision Finish ⁡ ( y ) \operatorname{Finish}(y) returns an answer and ends the task. Fixed-context QA is the terminal-decision case of this interface. The adapter defines the domain semantics, while the shared controller owns support admission, candidate membership checks, commitment, and actor fallback.

sents.en: The adapter defines the domain semantics, while the shared controller owns support admission, candidate membership checks, commitment, and actor fallback.
sents.zh: 适配器定义领域语义，而共享控制器负责支持准入、候选成员资格检查、承诺以及行动者回退。

paragraphs.en: The original actor parameters, original tools, and evaluator remain fixed. The integration requires a public-state adapter and does not assume that arbitrary task semantics can be inferred automatically.
paragraphs.zh: 原始的智能体参数、原始工具和评估器保持固定。 该集成需要一个公共状态适配器，并且不假设任意任务语义都可以自动推断出来。

paragraphs.en: The offline RSI loop follows a fixed proposal strategy. The current harness runs on training tasks; their execution feedback guides candidate instruction edits. Disjoint validation tasks determine which candidate to retain, and the retained harness supplies the next round’s training feedback. The selected configuration is frozen before final evaluation and deployment. Appendix B records the development protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 离线 RSI 循环遵循固定的提议策略。 当前的框架在训练任务上运行；这些任务的执行反馈用于指导候选指令的修改。 由互不重叠的验证任务决定保留哪个候选指令，而被保留的框架则提供下一轮的训练反馈。 所选配置在最终评估与部署之前被冻结。 附录 B 记录了开发流程。

paragraphs.en: Candidate production and support checks have separate roles. An action adapter can propose a tool command without calling a model; a QA adapter first pays for an actor-generated draft. The controller records the selected route and rejection reason, and the cost ledger includes all model calls made by either adapter. The benchmark scorer evaluates the selected decisions.
paragraphs.zh: 候选产出与支持性检查各自承担不同的角色。 动作适配器可以在不调用模型的情况下提出工具命令；而问答适配器则需先为智能体生成的草稿付费。 控制器记录所选路径及拒绝原因，成本账本则计入两个适配器所产生的所有模型调用。 基准评分器对所选决策进行评估。

paragraphs.en: For action tasks, the initial actor call supplies the first transition. Local execution then applies at every supported state. An explicit QA bypass supplies no candidate and skips draft generation, so the controller invokes the original answering procedure directly.
paragraphs.zh: 对于动作任务，初始的智能体调用提供第一个转移。 随后本地执行在每个受支持的状态上生效。 显式的问答旁路不提供候选并跳过草稿生成，因此控制器直接调用原始的问答流程。

paragraphs.en: The coding adapter separates constructing an action from deciding whether the current feedback permits it. In a slow turn, the original CoT actor [ 41 ] emits a terminal command and a bounded action bank, the serialized EDG. Each bank entry is b = ( ℓ , p , g , a ) b=(\ell,p,g,a) : a label ℓ \ell , a predecessor p p , a condition g g on public tool results, and literal tool arguments a a . A predecessor is the current root command or an earlier entry, so the bank defines an acyclic execution graph. The actor declares future commands only when their arguments are already determined; unseen data requires a new slow turn.
paragraphs.zh: 编码适配器将动作的构造与判断当前反馈是否允许该动作分离开来。 在慢轮次中，原始的 CoT 智能体 [ 41 ] 发出一个终止命令和一个有界的动作库，即序列化后的 EDG。 库中的每个条目为 b = ( ℓ , p , g , a ) b=(\ell,p,g,a) ：标签 ℓ \ell 、前驱 p p 、关于公共工具结果的判断条件 g g ，以及字面形式的工具参数 a a 。 前驱是当前的根命令或更早的条目，因此该动作库定义了一个无环执行图。 只有当参数已经确定时，智能体才会声明未来的命令；未看到的数据需要开启新的慢轮次。

paragraphs.en: After a command returns, the adapter exposes entries whose predecessor was that command. The fast selector receives the original user request, original tool schema, declared candidates and actual public results. It returns one candidate label or an abstention symbol. A selected label compiles into exactly that entry’s tool command, which executes once. The selector cannot invent commands or revise arguments. Empty banks, unparsed results, exceeded bank limits and abstention take the original slow path. Following each fast action, its new result determines the next eligible entries.
paragraphs.zh: 命令返回后，适配器会暴露以其为前驱的条目。 快速选择器接收原始用户请求、原始工具模式、声明的候选条目以及实际的公开结果。 它返回一个候选标签或弃权符号。 被选中的标签会编译为该条目对应的工具命令，且只执行一次。 选择器不能凭空编造命令或修改参数。 空候选库、结果解析失败、超出候选库限制以及弃权都会走原来的慢速路径。 每次快速操作之后，其新结果会决定下一批符合条件的条目。

paragraphs.en: The selector uses the same DeepSeek backbone as the slow actor, disables reasoning for the selection request, and generates one control token with model-reported log probabilities. Candidate membership and tool arguments are checked before execution. Benchmark tests evaluate the typed selection interface. The CoT-only control uses identical instructions and authors the same bank format with fast selection disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 选择器使用与慢速智能体相同的 DeepSeek 主干模型，在选择请求中禁用推理，并生成一个带有模型报告的对数概率的控制标记。 候选成员资格和工具参数在执行前进行检查。 基准测试评估该类型化选择接口。 仅 CoT 的对照使用相同的指令，并在禁用快速选择的情况下编写相同的库格式。

paragraphs.en: The fast request retains public constraints, candidate IDs, complete arguments and the observations needed for their guards. It omits the full tool catalog, skill library, trajectory and slow rationale; unsupported states defer before selection. Candidate construction, typed selection and context compaction retain their separate mechanism identities and complete costs. Historical adapter settings and interface probes remain in the external reproduction artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 快速请求保留公共约束、候选智能体 ID、完整参数，以及其守卫所需的观测。 它省略完整的工具目录、技能库、轨迹与慢速推理；不支持的状态会在选择之前先行延迟处理。 候选构建、类型化选择与上下文压缩保留各自独立的机制身份和完整成本。 历史适配器设置与接口探测保留在外部复现工件中。

paragraphs.en: Complete-task cost includes the slow actor’s bank authorship, every fast input and control token, failures and slow fallbacks. Cached inputs remain counted. The single-encoding policy supplies each decoded tool result once to the fast selector and binds it to the original receipt hash; the full original history remains available to slow reasoning. Noncanonical or unsupported observations defer to CoT. Section 5.3 distinguishes the implemented mechanism, its TRAIN comparison and final held-out evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 完成任务的成本包括慢速智能体的银行作者身份、每一个快速输入与控制令牌、失败以及慢速回退。 已缓存的输入仍被计入。 单一编码策略将每个解码后的工具结果一次性提供给快速选择器，并将其绑定到原始回执哈希；完整原始历史仍可供慢速推理使用。 非规范或不受支持的观测交由思维链处理。 5.3 节区分了已实现的机制、其 TRAIN 对比以及最终的留出证据。

paragraphs.en: The historical ALFWorld adapter has a different candidate producer: handwritten state tracking records pickup, transformations and placement, then selects the first tool action in the highest-priority supported group. It uses neither model selection nor probability scores. Table 8 and Figure 4 disable that controller and compare instructions under a common actor. These measurements are retained as instruction and historical-controller evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 历史 ALFWorld 适配器采用了不同的候选生成方式：手写的状态追踪记录拾取、转化和放置，然后在最高优先级的受支持组中选出第一个工具动作。 它既不使用模型选择，也不使用概率分数。 表 8 和图 4 禁用了该控制器，并在同一个执行器下比较各指令。 这些测量结果被保留下来，作为指令与历史控制器的证据。

paragraphs.en: An answer adapter supplies a terminal candidate to the same controller. The recorded text-QA adapter first generates a draft from the complete source context and retrieved original rule sentences, with fixed output budget L draft L_{\mathrm{draft}} . Its support predicate checks the answer format, source location, and explicit answer type. Acceptance returns the draft unchanged. Rejection calls the original actor with the full selected instructions. An input-only applicability check bypasses draft generation for explicit negative/comparison questions and multiple blanks.
paragraphs.zh: 答案适配器向同一控制器提供一个终止候选。 该基于记录文本的问答适配器首先根据完整的源上下文和检索到的原始规则句子生成草稿，其输出预算固定为 L draft L_{\mathrm{draft}}。 其支持性判定会检查答案格式、来源位置以及明确的答案类型。 接受时，草稿原样返回。 拒绝时，会以完整选定的指令调用原始智能体。 仅针对输入的适用性检查会绕过草稿生成，直接处理明确的否定/比较类问题以及多空格填空。

sents.zh: 答案适配器向同一控制器提供一个终止候选。

sents.en: Acceptance returns the draft unchanged.
sents.zh: 接受时，草稿原样返回。

sents.en: Rejection calls the original actor with the full selected instructions.
sents.zh: 拒绝时，会以完整选定的指令调用原始智能体。

sents.en: An input-only applicability check bypasses draft generation for explicit negative/comparison questions and multiple blanks.
sents.zh: 仅针对输入的适用性检查会绕过草稿生成，直接处理明确的否定/比较类问题以及多空格填空。

paragraphs.en: The draft is a model call, and fallback is a second model call. The original QA baseline has no separate verifier call to remove. This adapter can change request and response lengths while adding calls on rejected drafts; the action adapter instead avoids supported reasoning calls. Both are measured with complete-task accounting. Stored DELETE/MODIFY routing, source-rule retrieval, and the independently evaluated offline rule-development loop are specified in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 草稿是一次模型调用，回退是第二次模型调用。 原始问答基线没有可移除的单独验证器调用。 此适配器会在被拒草稿上增加调用，同时改变请求与响应长度；而动作适配器则避免受支持的推理调用。 两者都用完成任务核算来度量。 存储的 DELETE/MODIFY 路由、来源规则检索，以及单独评估的离线规则开发流程在附录 B 中给出。

sents.zh: 原始问答基线没有可移除的单独验证器调用。

sents.en: This adapter can change request and response lengths while adding calls on rejected drafts; the action adapter instead avoids supported reasoning calls.

sents.en: Both are measured with complete-task accounting.
sents.zh: 两者都用完成任务核算来度量。

sents.en: Stored DELETE/MODIFY routing, source-rule retrieval, and the independently evaluated offline rule-development loop are specified in Appendix B .
sents.zh: 存储的 DELETE/MODIFY 路由、来源规则检索，以及单独评估的离线规则开发流程在附录 B 中给出。

paragraphs.en: HarnessMM replaces repeated reasoning calls with stored actions through a contract between a slow author, a persistent executor and the existing native harness boundary. A directed action graph alone is a standard executable planning representation. Here each admitted continuation has immutable arguments, public feedback can only change its readiness, and the native request ledger records omission of a specified reasoning callback. These restrictions make reuse inspectable. They do not imply that every authored action is correct or every graph lowers cost.
paragraphs.zh: HarnessMM 通过慢速编写者、持久化执行器与现有原生 harness 边界之间的契约，用存储的动作取代重复的推理调用。 单单一个有向动作图只是一种标准的可执行规划表示。 在这里，每条被接纳的续接都拥有不可变的参数，公开反馈只能改变其就绪状态，而原生请求账本会记录指定的推理回调被省略的情况。 这些限制使重用变得可检查。 它们并不意味着每个被编写的动作都是正确的，也不意味着每个图都能降低成本。

sents.en: HarnessMM replaces repeated reasoning calls with stored actions through a contract between a slow author, a persistent executor and the existing native harness boundary.
sents.zh: HarnessMM 通过慢速编写者、持久化执行器与现有原生 harness 边界之间的契约，用存储的动作取代重复的推理调用。

sents.en: A directed action graph alone is a standard executable planning representation.
sents.zh: 单单一个有向动作图只是一种标准的可执行规划表示。

sents.en: Here each admitted continuation has immutable arguments, public feedback can only change its readiness, and the native request ledger records omission of a specified reasoning callback.
sents.zh: 在这里，每条被接纳的续接都拥有不可变的参数，公开反馈只能改变其就绪状态，而原生请求账本会记录指定的推理回调被省略的情况。

sents.en: These restrictions make reuse inspectable.
sents.zh: 这些限制使重用变得可检查。

sents.en: They do not imply that every authored action is correct or every graph lowers cost.
sents.zh: 它们并不意味着每个被编写的动作都是正确的，也不意味着每个图都能降低成本。

paragraphs.en: A graph instance contains an authored root action, a finite acyclic set of future nodes, literal native arguments, dependencies and public guards. Runtime state contains the completed native receipts, the remaining graph nodes and the public episode history. Graph content and runtime state are different objects: completing a predecessor changes the latter without rewriting the authored action.
paragraphs.zh: 一个图实例包含一个已编写的根动作、一个有限无环的未来节点集合、字面原生参数、依赖关系以及公共守卫条件。 运行时状态包含已完成的原生回执、剩余的图节点以及公共的情节历史。 图内容与运行时状态是不同的对象：完成一个前驱节点会改变后者，而不会重写已编写的动作。

sents.en: A graph instance contains an authored root action, a finite acyclic set of future nodes, literal native arguments, dependencies and public guards.
sents.zh: 一个图实例包含一个已编写的根动作、一个有限无环的未来节点集合、字面原生参数、依赖关系以及公共守卫条件。

sents.en: Runtime state contains the completed native receipts, the remaining graph nodes and the public episode history.
sents.zh: 运行时状态包含已完成的原生回执、剩余的图节点以及公共的情节历史。

sents.en: Graph content and runtime state are different objects: completing a predecessor changes the latter without rewriting the authored action.
sents.zh: 图内容与运行时状态是不同的对象：完成一个前驱节点会改变后者，而不会重写已编写的动作。

paragraphs.en: At a native decision boundary, register the parent callback and ingest the preceding public tool receipt. Validate its association with the action that produced it.
paragraphs.zh: 在原生决策边界处，注册父回调并摄取前序的公共工具回执。 校验其与产生该回执的操作之间的关联。

sents.en: At a native decision boundary, register the parent callback and ingest the preceding public tool receipt.
sents.zh: 在原生决策边界处，注册父回调并摄取前序的公共工具回执。

sents.en: Validate its association with the action that produced it.
sents.zh: 校验其与产生该回执的操作之间的关联。

paragraphs.en: Construct the eligible set from unresolved nodes whose dependencies are complete, public guards pass and arguments meet the adapter’s closure checks.
paragraphs.zh: 从未决节点中构建合格集合，这些节点需满足：依赖项已完备、公开守卫通过，且参数符合适配器的闭包检查。

paragraphs.en: If exactly one node is eligible, use the declared deterministic route. If several are eligible, the configured typed selector chooses a candidate ID or abstains. Charge any model-based selector input and output.
paragraphs.zh: 如果恰好有一个节点符合条件，则使用声明的确定性路由。 如果有多个节点符合条件，则由配置的类型化选择器选出一个候选 ID 或弃权。 对任何基于模型的智能体选择器的输入和输出进行计费。

sents.en: If exactly one node is eligible, use the declared deterministic route.
sents.zh: 如果恰好有一个节点符合条件，则使用声明的确定性路由。

sents.en: If several are eligible, the configured typed selector chooses a candidate ID or abstains.
sents.zh: 如果有多个节点符合条件，则由配置的类型化选择器选出一个候选 ID 或弃权。

sents.en: Charge any model-based selector input and output.
sents.zh: 对任何基于模型的智能体选择器的输入和输出进行计费。

paragraphs.en: On admission, execute the selected literal arguments through the original native interface. Record the result and compare it with the authored node. Emit an omission certificate only after checking execution and absence of the registered slow request. Mark the node completed and retain the unresolved remainder of the graph.
paragraphs.zh: 在接入时，通过原始本地接口执行所选的字面量参数。 记录结果并与已编写的节点进行比较。 仅在检查执行情况且确认未注册的慢请求不存在后，才签发省略证书。 将该节点标记为已完成，并保留图中未解决的剩余部分。

sents.en: On admission, execute the selected literal arguments through the original native interface.
sents.zh: 在接入时，通过原始本地接口执行所选的字面量参数。

sents.en: Record the result and compare it with the authored node.
sents.zh: 记录结果并与已编写的节点进行比较。

sents.zh: 将该节点标记为已完成，并保留图中未解决的剩余部分。

paragraphs.en: On rejection, an empty set or abstention, invoke the original slow actor with its public task context. Record the author request and any fallback. A newly authored graph replaces the unresolved remainder; already executed receipts remain in the episode history.
paragraphs.zh: 在被拒绝、结果为空集或弃权时，使用其公开任务上下文调用原始的慢速智能体。 记录作者请求及任何回退操作。 新编写的图将替换未解决的剩余部分；已执行的回执仍保留在episode历史记录中。

sents.en: On rejection, an empty set or abstention, invoke the original slow actor with its public task context.
sents.zh: 在被拒绝、结果为空集或弃权时，使用其公开任务上下文调用原始的慢速智能体。

sents.en: Record the author request and any fallback.

paragraphs.en: Continue under the common benchmark limits. A terminal answer uses the same commitment point and stops. The native scorer evaluates the complete task; the request ledger charges every paid call.
paragraphs.zh: 在通用基准限制下继续执行。 终端回答使用相同的提交点并停止。 原生评分器评估完整任务；请求账本对每一次付费调用进行计费。

paragraphs.en: Literal closure is a syntactic restriction: all executable arguments have concrete values, with no placeholder to bind from unseen feedback. It is checked by the action schema and candidate-membership audit. Semantic closure is stronger: prior reasoning has determined the action’s meaning and its future applicability is captured by the declared guard. A concrete command can still be semantically wrong. General semantic closure is therefore not established merely by parsing literal arguments.
paragraphs.zh: 字面封闭是一种句法限制：所有可执行的智能体实参都具有具体取值，没有供未见反馈绑定的占位符。 它由动作模式和候选成员资格审计来检查。 语义封闭更强：先前的推理已经确定了该动作的含义，其未来的适用性由所声明的守卫条件来刻画。 一个具体的命令仍可能在语义上是错误的。 因此，仅靠解析字面实参并不能确立一般的语义封闭。

paragraphs.en: This implication depends on the adapter and the authored guard. The implementation enforces the left-hand checks; complete native task evaluation measures their quality consequences. There is no statewise correctness guarantee for arbitrary tools or tasks.

paragraphs.en: Assume the configured adapter uses the validated graph and native interface, the graph objects are not modified after authoring, and the recorded receipts are faithful. A reused node executes the literal arguments authored for that node. The typed selector returns only a node ID; it has no argument-generation interface. Native dispatch reads the selected stored arguments, and certificate verification compares those values with the tool receipt. This establishes an execution invariant under the stated assumptions, independently of task success.
paragraphs.zh: 假设配置的适配器使用经过验证的图和原生接口，图对象在编写后未被修改，且记录的回执是真实可信的。 被复用的节点执行为该节点编写的字面量参数。 类型化选择器只返回一个节点 ID；它没有参数生成接口。 原生分发读取所选的存储参数，证书验证将这些值与工具回执进行比较。 在上述假设下，这就建立了一条与任务成功与否无关的执行不变量。

paragraphs.en: Initially, no future node is completed. At each transition, eligibility admits only a node whose predecessor receipts are in the completion map. A completed node is removed from the unresolved set. Induction over transitions therefore gives predecessor-respecting execution with at most one dispatch per node instance. The initial acyclicity check prevents a future node from requiring its own completion. A later author call can create an identical graph, but it is a separate paid authoring event.
paragraphs.zh: 初始时，没有任何未来节点完成。 在每次转换中，资格条件只允许前驱回执已在完成映射中的节点进入。 已完成的节点会从未解决集合中移除。 因此，对转换进行归纳可得：执行尊重前驱关系，且每个节点实例最多只被派发一次。 初始的无环性检查防止某个未来节点要求自身的完成。 后续的一次作者调用可以创建相同的图，但它是单独的付费作者事件。

sents.zh: 初始时，没有任何未来节点完成。

sents.zh: 在每次转换中，资格条件只允许前驱回执已在完成映射中的节点进入。

sents.en: A completed node is removed from the unresolved set.
sents.zh: 已完成的节点会从未解决集合中移除。

paragraphs.en: A valid certificate binds the authored graph instance, selected node, exact native arguments, predecessor receipt, tool receipt and registered callback. The physical request ledger independently establishes absence of the specified slow request at that boundary. This is a structural observation about the executed route. It does not establish an identical counterfactual trajectory, an absent call’s token quantity, or a task-quality improvement. Comparisons on the same full task sets measure these effects.
paragraphs.zh: 有效的证书绑定了所创作的图实例、所选节点、确切的本地参数、前驱回执、工具回执以及已注册的回调。 物理请求账本独立地证实在该边界处不存在指定的慢请求。 这是对所执行路由的结构性观察。 它并不能证实存在完全相同的反事实轨迹、被省略调用的令牌数量，或任务质量的提升。 在相同的完整任务集上的比较可以衡量这些效应。

sents.en: A valid certificate binds the authored graph instance, selected node, exact native arguments, predecessor receipt, tool receipt and registered callback.
sents.zh: 有效的证书绑定了所创作的图实例、所选节点、确切的本地参数、前驱回执、工具回执以及已注册的回调。

sents.en: The physical request ledger independently establishes absence of the specified slow request at that boundary.

sents.zh: 它并不能证实存在完全相同的反事实轨迹、被省略调用的令牌数量，或任务质量的提升。

sents.en: Comparisons on the same full task sets measure these effects.
sents.zh: 在相同的完整任务集上的比较可以衡量这些效应。

paragraphs.en: Let A A denote additional author and selector actor tokens and F F additional fallback tokens. If K K eliminated callbacks would have costs c 1 , … , c K c_{1},\ldots,c_{K} , a same-trajectory token calculation gives net saving only when ∑ j c j > A + F \sum_{j}c_{j}>A+F . Under the simplifying assumption of a common callback cost c > 0 c>0 , the condition is K > ( A + F ) / c K>(A+F)/c . This relation describes the dependence on reuse coverage; it is not a prediction of measured saving, because the omitted calls are not executed and the substituted trajectory can differ.
paragraphs.zh: 设 A 表示新增的作者与选择者智能体令牌，F 表示新增的回退令牌。 如果被消除的 K 次回调的成本分别为 c₁, …, c_K，则同轨迹令牌计算表明，只有当 ∑ⱼ cⱼ > A + F 时才会产生净节省。 在回调成本统一为 c > 0 的简化假设下，该条件为 K > (A + F) / c。 这一关系描述了对复用覆盖率的依赖性；它并非对实测节省值的预测，因为被省略的调用并未执行，且替代轨迹可能有所不同。

paragraphs.en: The reported estimator is instead the difference in total tokens across all episodes for each method. Every arm uses the same independent task membership and execution contract, and each arm’s numerator includes its actual author, selector, slow, finalization and paid unsuccessful calls. Shared authoring is assigned once to its declared population. Cached provider input remains counted under the token protocol. CPU guards and native tools affect time and behavior, but their work cannot be added to a token total without an independently defined resource conversion.
paragraphs.zh: 报告的估计量改为每种方法在所有回合中的总 token 数之差。 每个分支使用相同的独立任务归属与执行契约，且每个分支的分子包含其实际的作者、选择器、慢速、收尾以及付费失败调用。 共享撰写的成本一次性计入其声明的群体。 缓存的提供商输入仍按 token 协议计入。 CPU 守卫与原生工具会影响时间和行为，但若无独立定义的资源转换，其工作量无法计入 token 总量。

sents.en: The reported estimator is instead the difference in total tokens across all episodes for each method.
sents.zh: 报告的估计量改为每种方法在所有回合中的总 token 数之差。

sents.en: Every arm uses the same independent task membership and execution contract, and each arm’s numerator includes its actual author, selector, slow, finalization and paid unsuccessful calls.

sents.zh: 共享撰写的成本一次性计入其声明的群体。

sents.zh: 缓存的提供商输入仍按 token 协议计入。

paragraphs.en: ReWOO separates planning from tool observations and supports dependency-bound evidence variables [ 43 ] ; LLMCompiler plans and dispatches tool dependencies for parallel execution [ 19 ] . Voyager develops a library of executable skills reused across tasks [ 40 ] . ActionEngine constructs application-level state-machine memory, compiles task programs and repairs execution reactively [ 52 ] . HarnessMM shares executable planning and reuse with these approaches. Its narrower contract stores episode-specific literal actions, lets public receipts activate them without argument synthesis, and binds observed native execution to a removed harness callback. We do not compare these planning systems experimentally, so the present evidence establishes the contract and benefits against the declared native harnesses rather than superiority over all executable planners.
paragraphs.zh: ReWOO 将规划与工具观察分离，并支持依赖绑定的证据变量 [ 43 ]；LLMCompiler 规划并分发工具依赖以实现并行执行 [ 19 ]。 Voyager 开发了一个可在任务间复用的可执行技能库 [ 40 ]。 ActionEngine 构建应用级状态机记忆，编译任务程序并对执行进行响应式修复 [ 52 ]。 HarnessMM 与这些方法共享可执行的规划与复用机制。 它更窄的契约存储特定情节的字面动作，让公开的回执无需参数合成即可激活它们，并将观察到的原生执行绑定到一个已被移除的 harness 回调上。 我们没有对这些规划系统进行实验比较，因此现有证据确立的是该契约相对于声明的原生 harness 的效果与收益，而非优于所有可执行规划器的结论。

paragraphs.en: The core execution transformation has three operations: author literal future actions, retain and activate them using public feedback, and dispatch an eligible action while omitting its registered callback. Its controller selects an action route. A surrounding configuration fixes the author prompt, context serializer, native adapter and finalization rules before the run. Those settings determine what the controller receives; the controller does not search over them during an episode.
paragraphs.zh: 核心执行转换包含三个操作：撰写字面未来动作，利用公开反馈保留并激活它们，以及派发一个符合条件的动作同时省略其已注册的回调。 其控制器选择一条动作路由。 周围的配置在运行前固定撰写提示词、上下文序列化器、原生适配器和终结规则。 这些设置决定控制器接收什么内容；控制器在单个回合中不会对它们进行搜索。

paragraphs.en: This map also separates cost mechanisms. Shorter prompts or context change the tokens in a remaining call; EDG execution changes whether a registered call occurs. The MBPP ablations keep instruction, context and finalization settings fixed while varying graph reuse and callback execution. No experiment in this paper trains a general policy that dynamically composes these optimization techniques.

Method-specific mechanisms and native execution limits follow the configurations above.

paragraphs.en: The integrated coding results also change context management and finalization. Total call-count reduction can therefore exceed certificate counts; these quantities are not expected to agree. The MBPP ablation supplies a more direct intervention test but does not isolate the intrinsic value of recording a certificate from the value of exclusive routing. Certificates are a measurement mechanism, and their logging overhead is included where it makes model calls.
paragraphs.zh: 集成编码结果同样会改变上下文管理与最终定稿过程。 因此，调用次数的总降幅可以超过证书的数量；这两个量并不预期一致。 MBPP 消融实验提供了更直接的干预测试，但并未将记录证书的内在价值与独占路由的价值区分开来。 证书是一种度量机制，在涉及模型调用的环节中，其记录开销已计入在内。

paragraphs.en: Historical MBPP comparisons on 85 training tasks provide development mechanism evidence: Codex improves from 91.76% to 94.12% at 67.21 versus 59.78 Tokens/task (k); DeepSeek Harness improves from 85.88% to 94.12% at 15.46 Tokens/task (k) versus 11.91 Tokens/task (k). The DeepSeek candidate records 153 certified substitutions and 62 public-guard confirmations. Across 32 GAIA2 development scenarios, Codex improves from 37.50% to 40.62% at 907.06 versus 825.99 Tokens/task (k), and DeepSeek Harness improves from 40.62% to 46.88% at 891.75 Tokens/task (k) versus 750.53 Tokens/task (k). Figure 3 preserves the earlier four panels and adds two separate MiMo panels; the appendix records their evidence phases.
paragraphs.zh: 在85个训练任务上的历史MBPP对比提供了发展机制证据：Codex在67.21对59.78 Tokens/task (k)下从91.76%提升至94.12%；DeepSeek Harness在15.46 Tokens/task (k)对11.91 Tokens/task (k)下从85.88%提升至94.12%。 DeepSeek候选者记录了153次认证替换和62次公共防护栏确认。 在32个GAIA2开发场景中，Codex在907.06对825.99 Tokens/task (k)下从37.50%提升至40.62%，DeepSeek Harness在891.75对750.53 Tokens/task (k)下从40.62%提升至46.88%。 图3保留了此前的四个面板并新增了两个独立的MiMo面板；附录记录了它们的证据阶段。

paragraphs.en: The w/o skills condition averages 41.69% at 34.10 Tokens/task (k); mismatched-family and neutral instructions of equal token length reach 48.34% at 43.28 Tokens/task (k) and 41.37% at 43.26 Tokens/task (k). HarnessMM gains 24.00 points over the w/o skills condition while using 7.81% fewer tokens, and gains 24.33 points over neutral text with 27.33% fewer tokens. Every action uses the common actor and the same 50-step cap. Whiskers show the observed seed range; task identities are not independent across repetitions. Appendix I.3 preserves all per-seed counts, paired intervals and costs, including the two original seed-9401 reference conditions reused exactly once. These instruction ablations measure content effects under a common actor.

paragraphs.en: A complete CoT/Jev TEST comparison executes verified fast actions in 94.44% of episodes, yet costs 127.07% more than the original harness and loses 7.29 success points. It saves only 1.04% against CoT-only, with input tokens accounting for 98.53% of the actor ledger. The coding control on 18 training tasks likewise records 10, 12 and 13 successes for the original harness, CoT-only and CoT/Jev, while CoT/Jev costs 30.37% more than the original harness and 3.74% more than CoT-only. Appendix H preserves the complete controls and their costs.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 CoT/Jev TEST 对比在 94.44% 的回合中执行了经验证的快速动作，但成本比原始测试框架高出 127.07%，并损失了 7.29 个成功点。 相比仅 CoT，它只节省了 1.04%，其中输入令牌占智能体账本的 98.53%。 在 18 个训练任务上的编码对照同样记录了原始测试框架、仅 CoT 和 CoT/Jev 分别取得 10、12 和 13 次成功，而 CoT/Jev 的成本比原始测试框架高 30.37%，比仅 CoT 高 3.74%。 附录 H 保留了完整的对照实验及其成本。

paragraphs.en: The executable adapter requires a declared native boundary, literal action serialization, public-state guards, callback registration and complete request logging. External reproduction artifacts retain frozen task memberships, model and software identities, integer costs, selection configuration and complete native outcomes. Shared optimizers use training evidence; validation selects among frozen candidates, and selected held-out configurations remain unchanged. Benchmarks with historical development populations retain their actual phase rather than being relabeled as final tests.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行适配器需要声明式原生边界、字面动作序列化、公开状态守卫、回调注册以及完整的请求日志。 外部复现产物保留冻结的任务成员关系、模型与软件标识、整数成本、选择配置以及完整的原生结果。 共享优化器使用训练证据；验证在冻结的候选之间进行选择，且被选出的留出配置保持不变。 具有历史开发人群的基准测试保留其实际阶段，而不会被重新标记为最终测试。

sents.en: The executable adapter requires a declared native boundary, literal action serialization, public-state guards, callback registration and complete request logging.
sents.zh: 可执行适配器需要声明式原生边界、字面动作序列化、公开状态守卫、回调注册以及完整的请求日志。

sents.en: External reproduction artifacts retain frozen task memberships, model and software identities, integer costs, selection configuration and complete native outcomes.
sents.zh: 外部复现产物保留冻结的任务成员关系、模型与软件标识、整数成本、选择配置以及完整的原生结果。

sents.en: Shared optimizers use training evidence; validation selects among frozen candidates, and selected held-out configurations remain unchanged.
sents.zh: 共享优化器使用训练证据；验证在冻结的候选之间进行选择，且被选出的留出配置保持不变。

sents.en: Benchmarks with historical development populations retain their actual phase rather than being relabeled as final tests.
sents.zh: 具有历史开发人群的基准测试保留其实际阶段，而不会被重新标记为最终测试。

paragraphs.en: The controller preserves the parent’s tool permissions and action space. It does not enlarge those permissions or establish a general safety guarantee. Incorrect authorship, incomplete guards and changed tool semantics can affect task quality even when the structural certificate is valid. These cases are handled by the native evaluator and the declared quality constraint, not by treating omission evidence as correctness evidence.
paragraphs.zh: 控制器保留父级的工具权限与动作空间。 它不会扩大这些权限，也不会建立一般性的安全保证。 即使结构证书有效，错误的作者归属、不完整的防护以及工具语义的变化仍可能影响任务质量。 这些情况由原生评估器和声明的质量约束处理，而不是把省略证据当作正确性证据。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four conditions on the complete MBPP-sanitized release using a custom 85/85/257 training/validation/test partition, seed 20261005. DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 uses the shared backbone. All arms share the author prompt and schema, public context, native buffered parser, tools, decoding settings, one attempt per task, two workers per arm, and 300-second actor/30-second verifier limits. The tool working directory is /app ; the latest actual public-check call and result remain in public context. Authored public assertions must match the original problem line by line. Rejected banks retain their authoring cost and return to paid native slow reasoning. Disabled-thinking requests use the same transport mapping across arms; task reasoning and output limits remain fixed.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在完整的 MBPP-sanitized 发布版本上使用自定义的 85/85/257 训练/验证/测试划分评估四种条件，随机种子为 20261005。 DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 使用共享骨干。 所有分支共享作者提示词与模式、公共上下文、原生缓冲解析器、工具、解码设置、每个任务一次尝试、每个分支两个工作线程，以及 300 秒的执行者/30 秒的验证者时限。 工具工作目录为 /app；最近一次实际的公共检查调用及其结果保留在公共上下文中。 撰写的公共断言必须与原始问题逐行匹配。 被拒绝的题库保留其撰写成本，并回到付费的原生慢速推理。 禁用思考的请求在各分支间使用相同的传输映射；任务推理与输出限制保持固定。

Validation trajectories and test outcomes supply no method revisions. The final comparison contains all 1,028 task-arm executions. Tokens/task (k) include physical input and output from authorship, selectors, control, native recovery and unsuccessful executions, divided by 257 and 1,000.

paragraphs.en: Full HarnessMM combines GDR and CCS: GDR retains the executable graph across tool transitions; CCS replaces slow callbacks with authored actions and certifies their removal. W/o GDR (single-use EDG) discards the graph after its first certified execution, preserving its author and full authoring cost. W/o CCS (callbacks retained) retains a paid slow callback to regenerate each selected tool action. This intervention isolates callback substitution, not the independent benefit of certification. Without EDG execution preserves the author and its cost while disabling executable graph use.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 HarnessMM 结合了 GDR 和 CCS：GDR 在工具切换时保留可执行图；CCS 用编写好的动作替代缓慢的回调，并认证其移除。 去掉 GDR（单次使用 EDG）在首次认证执行后丢弃图，保留了其编写者和全部编写成本。 去掉 CCS（保留回调）则保留一个付费的缓慢回调，用于重新生成每个选定的工具动作。 该干预隔离了回调替换的作用，而非认证本身的独立收益。 不执行 EDG 在禁用可执行图使用的同时，保留了编写者及其成本。

paragraphs.en: Full HarnessMM performs 407 certified bypasses; 201 graphs are reused twice. W/o GDR performs 212 bypasses and discards 212 graphs. The retained-callback condition performs 257 paid regenerations and zero certified bypasses; disabling EDG produces zero bypasses. Full HarnessMM solves two more tasks than W/o GDR while reducing measured complete cost by 26.91%. Compared with retained callbacks it solves one more task at 19.52% lower cost. Relative to disabled EDG, its 18.62% cost saving accompanies four fewer correct tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 完整 HarnessMM 执行了 407 次认证绕过；其中 201 个图被重复使用两次。 去除 GDR（W/o GDR）执行了 212 次绕过并丢弃了 212 个图。 保留回调条件执行了 257 次付费重生成且零次认证绕过；禁用 EDG 则产生零次绕过。 完整 HarnessMM 比去除 GDR 多解决两个任务，同时将测得的完整成本降低 26.91%。 与保留回调相比，它多解决一个任务且成本降低 19.52%。 相对于禁用 EDG，其 18.62% 的成本节省伴随着少解决的四个正确任务。

paragraphs.en: We use the complete 427-task MBPP-sanitized release with a custom 85/85/257 training/validation/test partition, seed 20261005. Deterministic rounding implements the required 20/20/60 ratio; task membership is disjoint and common to all arms. The parent is DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 with the shared backbone. All conditions share the public task interface, native tools, decoding settings, two workers per arm, one execution per task and 300-second actor/30-second verifier deadlines. Correctness evaluates every released assertion. Reference implementations are absent from the actor workspace.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用完整的 427 任务 MBPP-sanitized 版本，采用自定义的 85/85/257 训练/验证/测试划分，随机种子为 20261005。 确定性取整实现了所需的 20/20/60 比例；任务成员关系互斥且对所有分支相同。 父框架为 DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1，带有共享主干。 所有条件共享公开的任务接口、原生工具、解码设置、每个分支两个工作线程、每个任务一次执行，以及 300 秒的 actor 超时/30 秒的验证器超时。 正确性评估每一条发布的断言。 参考实现不出现在 actor 工作空间中。

paragraphs.en: Training supplies the structured author and frozen intervention definitions. The complete training comparison uses 85 tasks; disjoint validation selects frozen candidates without returning trajectories or failures to optimization. The historical evaluation uses the complete 257-task test population for every arm. Test outcomes supply no selection or revisions; the external archive retains every arm and execution.
paragraphs.zh: 训练提供结构化的作者和冻结的干预定义。 完整的训练比较使用 85 个任务；不相交的验证在不将轨迹或失败信息返回给优化的情况下选出冻结的候选者。 历史评估对每个分支使用完整的 257 个任务测试总体。 测试结果不提供任何选择或修订；外部存档保留每个分支及其执行记录。

sents.en: Training supplies the structured author and frozen intervention definitions.
sents.zh: 训练提供结构化的作者和冻结的干预定义。

sents.zh: 历史评估对每个分支使用完整的 257 个任务测试总体。

sents.zh: 测试结果不提供任何选择或修订；外部存档保留每个分支及其执行记录。

paragraphs.en: The original harness uses ordinary slow reasoning without EDG authoring or fast routing. Full HarnessMM combines the structured EDG, public eligibility checks and certified callback bypass. W/o GDR (the single-use GDR control) preserves the author and graph capacity, but discards unused nodes after its first certified execution. Unused authored nodes still incur cost.
paragraphs.zh: 原始测试框架使用普通的慢速推理，不包含 EDG 编写或快速路由。 完整的 HarnessMM 结合了结构化 EDG、公开资格检查和经认证的回调绕过。 无 GDR（单次使用的 GDR 对照设置）保留编写者与图容量，但在其第一次经认证的执行后丢弃未使用的节点。 未使用的已编写节点仍会产生成本。

sents.en: The original harness uses ordinary slow reasoning without EDG authoring or fast routing.
sents.zh: 原始测试框架使用普通的慢速推理，不包含 EDG 编写或快速路由。

sents.en: Full HarnessMM combines the structured EDG, public eligibility checks and certified callback bypass.
sents.zh: 完整的 HarnessMM 结合了结构化 EDG、公开资格检查和经认证的回调绕过。

sents.en: W/o GDR (the single-use GDR control) preserves the author and graph capacity, but discards unused nodes after its first certified execution.
sents.zh: 无 GDR（单次使用的 GDR 对照设置）保留编写者与图容量，但在其第一次经认证的执行后丢弃未使用的节点。

sents.en: Unused authored nodes still incur cost.
sents.zh: 未使用的已编写节点仍会产生成本。

paragraphs.en: The W/o CCS condition keeps fast selection but asks the same slow actor to regenerate exactly one tool action before execution. Changed arguments invalidate dependent nodes; invalid regeneration returns control to slow reasoning. A retained callback receives no substitution certificate. Graph authorship, selector input and control, regeneration, fallbacks and unsuccessful executions all contribute to Tokens/task (k), normalized by the full 257-task population. Development and selection costs remain separate from final execution.
paragraphs.zh: 无 CCS 条件保留了快速选择，但要求同一个慢速智能体在执行前重新生成恰好一个工具动作。 参数变更会使依赖节点失效；无效的重新生成会将控制权交还给慢速推理。 被保留的回调不会获得替换证书。 图谱编写、选择器输入与控制、重新生成、回退以及未成功的执行都计入 Tokens/任务（千），并按全部 257 个任务的总体进行归一化。 开发与选择成本仍与最终执行分开统计。

sents.en: The W/o CCS condition keeps fast selection but asks the same slow actor to regenerate exactly one tool action before execution.
sents.zh: 无 CCS 条件保留了快速选择，但要求同一个慢速智能体在执行前重新生成恰好一个工具动作。

sents.en: Changed arguments invalidate dependent nodes; invalid regeneration returns control to slow reasoning.
sents.zh: 参数变更会使依赖节点失效；无效的重新生成会将控制权交还给慢速推理。

sents.en: A retained callback receives no substitution certificate.
sents.zh: 被保留的回调不会获得替换证书。

sents.en: Graph authorship, selector input and control, regeneration, fallbacks and unsuccessful executions all contribute to Tokens/task (k), normalized by the full 257-task population.
sents.zh: 图谱编写、选择器输入与控制、重新生成、回退以及未成功的执行都计入 Tokens/任务（千），并按全部 257 个任务的总体进行归一化。

sents.en: Development and selection costs remain separate from final execution.
sents.zh: 开发与选择成本仍与最终执行分开统计。

paragraphs.en: Full HarnessMM reduces cost by 76.19% relative to the original harness and increases observed correctness by 2.72 percentage points. The paired 95% interval for the correctness difference is [ − 1.95 , 7.39 ] [-1.95,7.39] points; it does not establish a significant accuracy gain. Full HarnessMM makes 459 certified substitutions, with at least two bypasses in 228 authored graphs. W/o GDR (the single-use GDR control) makes 237 substitutions and discards 237 graphs after one use. Recorded slow calls per task rise from 4.49 for full HarnessMM to 5.42 for the single-use GDR control and 6.41 when callbacks are retained. The retained-callback condition records 281 callbacks and 280 regenerated actions, with zero certified bypasses.
paragraphs.zh: Full HarnessMM 相对于原始 harness 将成本降低了 76.19%，并将观察到的正确性提高了 2.72 个百分点。 正确性差异的配对 95% 区间为 [−1.95, 7.39] 个百分点；它并未确立显著的准确率提升。 Full HarnessMM 进行了 459 次认证替换，在 228 个编写的图中至少出现两次绕过。 W/o GDR（单次使用 GDR 对照）进行了 237 次替换，并在一次使用后丢弃了 237 个图。 每个任务记录的慢调用次数从 full HarnessMM 的 4.49 上升到单次使用 GDR 对照的 5.42，以及保留回调时的 6.41。 保留回调条件记录了 281 次回调与 280 次重新生成的动作，认证绕过为零。

sents.en: Full HarnessMM reduces cost by 76.19% relative to the original harness and increases observed correctness by 2.72 percentage points.
sents.zh: Full HarnessMM 相对于原始 harness 将成本降低了 76.19%，并将观察到的正确性提高了 2.72 个百分点。

sents.en: The paired 95% interval for the correctness difference is [ − 1.95 , 7.39 ] [-1.95,7.39] points; it does not establish a significant accuracy gain.

sents.en: Full HarnessMM makes 459 certified substitutions, with at least two bypasses in 228 authored graphs.
sents.zh: Full HarnessMM 进行了 459 次认证替换，在 228 个编写的图中至少出现两次绕过。

sents.en: W/o GDR (the single-use GDR control) makes 237 substitutions and discards 237 graphs after one use.
sents.zh: W/o GDR（单次使用 GDR 对照）进行了 237 次替换，并在一次使用后丢弃了 237 个图。

sents.en: Recorded slow calls per task rise from 4.49 for full HarnessMM to 5.42 for the single-use GDR control and 6.41 when callbacks are retained.
sents.zh: 每个任务记录的慢调用次数从 full HarnessMM 的 4.49 上升到单次使用 GDR 对照的 5.42，以及保留回调时的 6.41。

sents.zh: 保留回调条件记录了 281 次回调与 280 次重新生成的动作，认证绕过为零。

paragraphs.en: The additional EDG reuse is active, but the single-use GDR control has slightly higher correctness and lower aggregate cost in this comparison. Retaining slow callbacks increases measured cost by 10.34% and correctness by 1.56 points; the paired intervals include equal cost and correctness. One execution per task measures task-level variation rather than run-to-run variability.
paragraphs.zh: 额外的 EDG 复用是激活的，但在本次对比中，单次使用的 GDR 控制具有略高的正确性和更低的聚合成本。 保留慢回调会使测得的成本增加 10.34%，正确性增加 1.56 分；成对的区间包含相等的成本和正确性。 每个任务执行一次衡量的是任务级差异，而非运行间差异。
