sents.zh: 额外的 EDG 复用是激活的，但在本次对比中，单次使用的 GDR 控制具有略高的正确性和更低的聚合成本。

sents.zh: 每个任务执行一次衡量的是任务级差异，而非运行间差异。

paragraphs.en: All four arms use the same 98 test tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 所有四个智能体都使用相同的 98 个测试任务。

paragraphs.en: The Codex+HarnessMM and DeepSeek Harness+HarnessMM conditions contain 18 and 147 unique valid substitution certificates, respectively; both original harnesses have zero. Each binds literal arguments, an original tool, a receipt hash, a predecessor and a bypassed callback ID; the audit checks no intervening slow request and unchanged slow-sequence count at the boundary. The certificate rates are 18/98=0.18 and 147/98=1.50 per task. Complete execution cost is 11.62 Tokens/task (k); it includes the whole cohort rather than only certified substitutions.

paragraphs.en: Local decisions require a task-specific public-state adapter and support rules. The interactive measurements use textual ALFWorld observations; they do not establish visual-agent improvement. The ALFWorld instruction comparison transfers archived optimized policies without rerunning their optimizers. The custom test uses one seed and shares some floorplans across partitions. The ALFWorld comparisons and text-QA studies use previously exposed public data. GQA grounding and generic instructions of equal token length both score 65% in the small visual pilot. The separate rule-development pilot accepts no updates.

paragraphs.en: In v20, 281 fast attempts produce 249 locally bypassed slow callbacks; 32 abstentions incur 212.17 slow-fallback Tokens/task (k). Fast requests cost 50.46 Tokens/task (k), including 18.91 input Tokens/task (k). Their removal alone would save only 1.18% of the complete bank-arm cost. The arm still makes 618 slow calls against 502 baseline attempts. It uses 79.68% more tokens and loses 6.25 success points despite fast actions in 93.75% of episodes.

paragraphs.en: The passive benchmark audit verifies 227 local substitutions in 31 episodes; 22 compiled actions in one failed SDK episode remain unresolved. Bank-bearing slow requests jointly perform reasoning and candidate construction, so their full request cost is not an isolated authoring cost.
paragraphs.zh: 被动基准审计验证了 31 个片段中的 227 处本地替换；一个失败的 SDK 片段中的 22 个已编译动作仍未解决。 带有银行（bank）的慢请求同时执行推理和候选构造，因此其完整请求成本并非孤立的编写成本。

paragraphs.en: The v22 revision reduces slow calls from 15.69 to 12.63 per episode and saves 15.55% at 43.75% versus 40.62% baseline success. Renewing banks at every slow step in v23 raises cost by 20.20% and loses one success. The full training attribution and all historical interface probes remain in the external evidence and reproduction artifacts.

paragraphs.en: Finally, uncertainty in model evaluation arises at multiple levels: task sampling, prompt choice, random seeds, execution order, and numerical/runtime behavior [ 31 , 48 , 10 ] . Repeating one task characterizes its execution distribution, with the task remaining the independent sampling unit. We use paired source-group estimates, retain all comparison endpoints, and separate exploratory inspection from frozen comparisons [ 7 , 32 , 6 ] . Crossed and nested dependence must be treated explicitly rather than pooling all response cells as independent samples [ 29 ] . Efficient serving mechanisms such as PagedAttention address execution resources [ 20 ] ; repeated-request controls characterize variability under the chosen runtime.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，模型评估中的不确定性出现在多个层面：任务抽样、提示选择、随机种子、执行顺序以及数值/运行时行为 [ 31 , 48 , 10 ] 。 重复同一任务可刻画其执行分布，同时任务仍保持为独立抽样单元。 我们使用配对的源组估计，保留所有比较终点，并将探索性检查与冻结的比较分开 [ 7 , 32 , 6 ] 。 交叉与嵌套依赖必须被显式处理，而不是把所有响应单元合并为独立样本 [ 29 ] 。 诸如 PagedAttention 之类的高效服务机制用于处理执行资源 [ 20 ] ；而重复请求控制则刻画在所选运行时下的变异性。

sents.en: Finally, uncertainty in model evaluation arises at multiple levels: task sampling, prompt choice, random seeds, execution order, and numerical/runtime behavior [ 31 , 48 , 10 ] .

sents.en: Repeating one task characterizes its execution distribution, with the task remaining the independent sampling unit.
sents.zh: 重复同一任务可刻画其执行分布，同时任务仍保持为独立抽样单元。

sents.en: We use paired source-group estimates, retain all comparison endpoints, and separate exploratory inspection from frozen comparisons [ 7 , 32 , 6 ] .

sents.en: Crossed and nested dependence must be treated explicitly rather than pooling all response cells as independent samples [ 29 ] .
sents.zh: 交叉与嵌套依赖必须被显式处理，而不是把所有响应单元合并为独立样本 [ 29 ] 。

sents.en: Efficient serving mechanisms such as PagedAttention address execution resources [ 20 ] ; repeated-request controls characterize variability under the chosen runtime.
sents.zh: 诸如 PagedAttention 之类的高效服务机制用于处理执行资源 [ 20 ] ；而重复请求控制则刻画在所选运行时下的变异性。

paragraphs.en: The closest evaluation alternatives already address substantial parts of our question. FormatSpread quantifies spurious prompt-format sensitivity [ 35 ] ; ProSA and POSIX examine prompt sensitivity at finer granularity [ 54 , 3 ] ; PromptEval estimates performance distributions over prompts efficiently [ 31 ] . PARC analyzes language/image transformations in vision-language models, with certainty derived from conformal answer scores rather than repeated execution [ 34 ] . Our comparisons combine instruction-content controls with repeated execution and image interventions. They examine how these sources of variation affect the interpretation of a quality–cost comparison.
paragraphs.zh: 最接近的评估工作已经涉及了我们问题的大部分内容。 FormatSpread 量化了虚假的提示格式敏感性 [ 35 ] ；ProSA 和 POSIX 在更细的粒度上考察提示敏感性 [ 54 , 3 ] ；PromptEval 高效地估计提示上的性能分布 [ 31 ] 。 PARC 分析视觉-语言模型中的语言/图像变换，其确定性来自保形答案分数而非重复执行 [ 34 ] 。 我们的比较将指令内容控制、重复执行与图像干预相结合。 它们考察这些变异来源如何影响质量-成本比较的解释。

sents.en: The closest evaluation alternatives already address substantial parts of our question.
sents.zh: 最接近的评估工作已经涉及了我们问题的大部分内容。

sents.en: FormatSpread quantifies spurious prompt-format sensitivity [ 35 ] ; ProSA and POSIX examine prompt sensitivity at finer granularity [ 54 , 3 ] ; PromptEval estimates performance distributions over prompts efficiently [ 31 ] .
sents.zh: FormatSpread 量化了虚假的提示格式敏感性 [ 35 ] ；ProSA 和 POSIX 在更细的粒度上考察提示敏感性 [ 54 , 3 ] ；PromptEval 高效地估计提示上的性能分布 [ 31 ] 。

sents.en: PARC analyzes language/image transformations in vision-language models, with certainty derived from conformal answer scores rather than repeated execution [ 34 ] .
sents.zh: PARC 分析视觉-语言模型中的语言/图像变换，其确定性来自保形答案分数而非重复执行 [ 34 ] 。

sents.en: Our comparisons combine instruction-content controls with repeated execution and image interventions.
sents.zh: 我们的比较将指令内容控制、重复执行与图像干预相结合。

sents.en: They examine how these sources of variation affect the interpretation of a quality–cost comparison.
sents.zh: 它们考察这些变异来源如何影响质量-成本比较的解释。

paragraphs.en: Vision-language systems combine image representations with instruction following, and visual-programming approaches expose intermediate operations that can be inspected or recombined [ 22 , 37 ] . These approaches motivate treating instructions as controls over visual decisions. Balanced and compositional benchmarks, contrastive examples, and image interventions examine complementary aspects of this problem [ 11 , 14 , 18 , 26 ] . Our true-image and shuffled-image conditions provide a within-sample diagnostic of image dependence. The same commit-or-defer interface accepts terminal answers. A text-QA adapter obtains an actor-generated draft, checks its source, type, and format, and either returns it or calls the original answering procedure. The draft and fallback are both charged. The action adapter can avoid reasoning calls, whereas the answer adapter changes request and response lengths. Both preserve the benchmark task interface, and complete-task accounting covers every model call along either path.
paragraphs.zh: 视觉-语言系统将图像表示与指令遵循相结合，而视觉编程方法暴露出可供检查或重组的中间操作 [ 22 , 37 ] 。 这些方法启发我们将指令视为对视觉决策的控制。 平衡且具组合性的基准、对比示例以及图像干预检验了该问题的互补方面 [ 11 , 14 , 18 , 26 ] 。 我们的真实图像与打乱图像两种条件提供了一种样本内的图像依赖性诊断。 同一个提交或延迟接口接受终止性答案。 文本问答适配器获取由智能体生成的草稿，检查其来源、类型与格式，然后要么返回该草稿，要么调用原始的问答流程。 草稿与回退路径均被计入开销。 动作适配器可以避免推理调用，而答案适配器会改变请求与响应的长度。 两者都保留了基准任务接口，且完成任务核算覆盖任一路径上的每一次模型调用。

paragraphs.en: Figures 2 (a) and 4 use the same 2,133 test identities and seed 9401. The complete 3,553-task official TRAIN pool is partitioned into 710 training, 710 validation and 2,133 test tasks. Goal/scene trial variants stay together; the 240 known predecessor development tasks remain in training. This is a custom partition of previously exposed public data, with some floorplans shared across splits. The selected instructions and common actor are frozen before fresh execution. Training supplies six task-family operability checks per condition. All 710 validation tasks per condition must pass benchmark replay and cost verification before the complete test phase opens. No validation or test outcome selects or changes a policy.
paragraphs.zh: 图 2 (a) 和图 4 使用相同的 2,133 个测试身份和种子 9401。 完整的 3,553 个任务的官方 TRAIN 池被划分为 710 个训练、710 个验证和 2,133 个测试任务。 目标/场景试验变体保持在一起；240 个已知的前驱开发任务保留在训练中。 这是对先前已暴露的公开数据的自定义划分，部分户型图在不同划分之间共享。 所选指令和公共执行者在新执行之前被冻结。 训练为每个条件提供六项任务族可操作性检查。 每个条件的全部 710 个验证任务必须通过基准重放和成本验证，才能开启完整的测试阶段。 任何验证或测试结果都不会选择或改变策略。

paragraphs.en: All four displayed conditions share Qwen3.5-9B, temperature zero, disabled thinking, two-step history, a 2,048-token response cap and the benchmark 50-step limit. The instruction comparison deploys archived optimized artifacts without rerunning SkillOpt or AutoSaddler optimization. The skill-removal pair compares the frozen HarnessMM instructions with empty task-family instruction strings, producing the same No Skill condition as Figure 2 (a). Both use the original actor for every action. All unsuccessful episodes remain in both denominators.
paragraphs.zh: 所有四种展示条件均使用 Qwen3.5-9B、温度为零、禁用思考、两步历史、2048 token 的响应上限以及基准测试的 50 步限制。 指令对比部署了归档的优化产物，而未重新运行 SkillOpt 或 AutoSaddler 优化。 移除技能的对比组将冻结的 HarnessMM 指令与空的任务族指令字符串进行比较，产生与图 2（a）相同的无技能条件。 两者在每个动作中都使用原始智能体。 所有不成功的回合均保留在两个分母中。

paragraphs.en: Adding the frozen task-family skills gives 603 paired gains and 93 losses, a net 23.91-point difference (pointwise 95% floorplan-cluster interval [19.15, 28.34]). It reduces complete-task model tokens by 8.60%. This is a secondary descriptive comparison selected for the current ablation presentation after execution; it does not replace the archived campaign’s predeclared primary contrast.
paragraphs.zh: 加入冻结的任务族技能带来 603 对提升与 93 对下降，净差异为 23.91 分（按平面布置图聚类的逐点 95% 区间 [19.15, 28.34]）。 它将完整任务模型令牌数减少了 8.60%。 这是在执行后为当前消融展示而选取的次要描述性比较，它不能替代已归档活动的预先声明的主要对照。

paragraphs.en: All 8,532 displayed test executions pass independent environment trajectory replay and complete provider accounting, following 2,840 validation executions and 24 training operability checks for these four policies. Their test execution costs 51.70 Tokens/task (k). The original acquisition also contains a retired handwritten-controller condition, which is excluded from the current comparison and ablation. All of its records and costs remain preserved. Complete research acquisition costs, including retired conditions and historical optimization, remain separate in the external evidence. Cumulative token termination is disabled.
paragraphs.zh: 所有显示的 8,532 次测试执行均通过独立环境轨迹重放和完整的提供商核算，此前对这四个策略还进行了 2,840 次验证执行和 24 次训练可操作性检查。 其测试执行成本为 51.70 Tokens/task (k)。 原始采集还包含一个已弃用的手写控制器条件，该条件不包含在当前比较和消融实验中。 其所有记录和成本均被保留。 完整的科研采集成本（包括已弃用条件和历史优化）在外部证据中单独列出。 累计 token 终止已禁用。

paragraphs.en: The source bundle’s evidence/alfworld_fresh226_panel.json binds the complete global audit, all seven benchmark-audited test receipts, frozen policies, exact split membership and figure reproduction code. The earlier 134-task and development set (60 tasks) measurements remain archived and do not populate either current ALFWorld figure.

paragraphs.en: The historical full comparison uses all 16,980 public MRQA SearchQA development questions and the official EM/F1 scorer [ 8 ] . All seven conditions in Table 10 use fresh executions with the ALFWorld Qwen3.5-9B checkpoint, BF16, temperature zero, disabled thinking, seed 20260918, a 32,768-token context and a 512-token output cap per call. SkillOpt and AutoSaddler deploy archived optimized instructions. The refined controller removes only the question-echo rejection from the preceding recovery condition.
paragraphs.zh: 历史全量对比使用全部 16,980 个公开的 MRQA SearchQA 开发集问题以及官方 EM/F1 评分器 [ 8 ]。 表 10 中的全部七个条件均使用 ALFWorld Qwen3.5-9B 检查点进行全新执行，采用 BF16、温度为零、禁用思考、种子 20260918、32,768 个词元的上下文以及每次调用 512 个词元的输出上限。 SkillOpt 与 AutoSaddler 部署归档的优化后指令。 改进后的控制器仅移除了前一恢复条件中的问题回显拒绝部分。

paragraphs.en: HarnessMM adds 18 exact matches to original HarnessMM while saving 22.75% of tokens, but remains more expensive than No Skill and AutoSaddler. The complete study contains 118,860 outcomes, 119,768 actor calls and 2.27 Tokens/task (k), with no unknown usage. In the separate preceding six-condition run, tracing 500 actual post-draft recoveries gives 19 corrections and one regression. All corrections follow source-location rejection; 105 echo-triggered recoveries add 0.67 Tokens/task (k), averaged over the 500 audited recoveries without an EM gain. Against a freshly generated no-recovery control, that preceding recovery arm adds 12 exact matches at 4.04% higher cost. The distinction separates recovery within a recorded draft from variability between independently generated drafts. Its complete records remain in generated/searchqa_full_9b_appendix.tex .
paragraphs.zh: HarnessMM 在原始 HarnessMM 的基础上增加了 18 个精确匹配，同时节省了 22.75% 的 token，但成本仍高于 No Skill 和 AutoSaddler。 完整研究包含 118,860 个结果、119,768 次智能体调用以及 2.27 Tokens/task (k)，且没有未知用量。 在单独的前置六条件运行中，追踪 500 次真实的草稿后恢复得到 19 次修正和一次回归。 所有修正都遵循源位置拒绝；105 次回声触发的恢复增加了 0.67 Tokens/task (k)，该数值是对 500 次被审计的恢复取平均的结果，且没有带来 EM 增益。 与新生成的无恢复对照组相比，前置恢复分支以高 4.04% 的成本增加了 12 个精确匹配。 这一区分将记录草稿内部的恢复与独立生成草稿之间的变异性分离开来。 其完整记录保留在 generated/searchqa_full_9b_appendix.tex 中。

paragraphs.en: The same full-source recovery adapter is evaluated with frozen Qwen3.8-27B on four complete MRQA development archives (Table 11 ). BF16, temperature zero, disabled thinking, seed 20260918 and the 512-token per-call output cap are common to all conditions. HotpotQA’s checksum-verified archive contains all 5,901 questions. TriviaQA uses the complete web archive.

paragraphs.en: Recovery adds 0.05–0.15 EM points over the no-recovery draft at higher cost. Relative to original HarnessMM, SearchQA gains 14 exact matches but loses 0.004 F1 points, hidden by rounding in the table; the other three datasets improve both metrics. HarnessMM exceeds all three external prompt controls in EM and F1, while No Skill and AutoSaddler use fewer tokens. These are single-seed point estimates.

paragraphs.en: LiveMath uses one answer-first voter selected on 23 development tasks, with temperature zero, disabled thinking and a 256-token output cap. It requests <answer>X</answer> and <confidence>N</confidence> within the first 20 tokens; the confidence value does not trigger a second vote or fallback. The SkillOpt seed uses a 4,096-token cap, and AutoSaddler selects that same prompt. Instruction and cap therefore change jointly. SkillOpt uses 1.51 input and 3.34 output Tokens/task (k); HarnessMM uses 0.82 input and 0.01 output Tokens/task (k). Both make 160 calls. Output accounts for 82.87% of the 4.01 Tokens/task (k) saving. The paired quality comparison has 29 gains and 16 losses (two-sided McNemar p = 0.07245 p=0.07245 ). The archived service records a model alias rather than an immutable checkpoint.

paragraphs.en: The instruction module improves the original coding harness’s development outcomes while reducing complete-task token use (Table 13 ). The study uses all 18 TRAIN tasks in the frozen 18/18/53 Terminal-Bench 2.0 partition [ 12 ] , Codex 0.142.5 [ 28 ] and DeepSeek-flash. The original task, common completion brief, original tools, task limits and binary verifier are identical across conditions. The built-in-compaction control uses Codex’s own 65,536-token trigger without reducing the model’s context capacity.

paragraphs.en: Both proposed instructions solve 14 tasks. The second retains that training success count while reducing actor tokens from 2202.94 to 1455.83 Tokens/task (k). It requires persisting every requested artifact, checking exact paths and fields, extending working interfaces, and recovering from observed setup errors before optional exploration. Against the corrected original harness, it gains four successes and uses 39.68% fewer actor tokens; against built-in compaction, it gains two successes and uses 29.25% fewer. Descriptive paired-task bootstrap intervals for the training score differences are [ 5.56 , 44.44 ] [5.56,44.44] and [ − 11.11 , 33.33 ] [-11.11,33.33] percentage points, respectively (10,000 resamples, seed 20260928). The selected instruction is frozen for a separate four-arm study on 18 validation and 53 TEST tasks, with five executions per TEST task.

paragraphs.en: We then adapt AutoSOTA’s objective-and-reflection workflow [ 39 ] to built-in context management. This is a workflow adaptation, with the official CLI unused. The search holds the instruction and original execution settings fixed, requires at least the instruction’s 14 successes, and minimizes complete-task input-plus-output tokens. Its first round tests a 32,768-token compaction trigger; the frozen feedback rule chooses a shorter trigger only if quality is preserved and tokens fall, and a longer trigger otherwise. The 40% parent-relative saving target does not end the search early.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，我们将 AutoSOTA 的目标与反思工作流 [39] 适配到内置的上下文管理上。 这是一次工作流层面的适配，并未使用官方 CLI。 搜索将指令和原始执行设置保持固定，要求至少达到该指令的 14 次成功，并最小化完整任务的输入加输出 token 数。 其第一轮测试了 32768 token 的压缩触发阈值；冻结的反馈规则仅在质量得以保持且 token 数下降时选择更短的触发阈值，否则选择更长的触发阈值。 相对父节点 40% 的节省目标并不会让搜索提前结束。

sents.zh: 其第一轮测试了 32768 token 的压缩触发阈值；冻结的反馈规则仅在质量得以保持且 token 数下降时选择更短的触发阈值，否则选择更长的触发阈值。

paragraphs.en: The complete 32Ki round uses 1068.67 actor Tokens/task (k): 55.72% fewer tokens than the original harness and 26.59% fewer than the instruction module. It solves 61.11% of tasks and loses three of the instruction’s successes, with no gains over that instruction. The paired training-score difference is − 16.67 -16.67 percentage points (descriptive 95% task-bootstrap interval [ − 33.33 , 0.00 ] [-33.33,0.00] ). The quality guard rejects this candidate and evaluates the frozen 98,304-token successor. That round also solves 61.11% of tasks, with one gain and four losses relative to the instruction. Its paired training-score difference is − 16.67 -16.67 percentage points (descriptive 95% task-bootstrap interval [ − 38.89 , 5.56 ] [-38.89,5.56] ). It uses 1176.39 actor Tokens/task (k), 51.26% fewer than the original harness and 19.20% fewer than the instruction, but 10.08% more than the 32Ki round. Both candidates therefore fail the 77.78% quality requirement and remain ineligible for protected validation. The two completed rounds add 2245.06 Tokens/task (k) to development expenditure. Table 13 retains both complete trade-offs. The original harness and selected instruction remain in this TRAIN table. Figure 3 reserves coding cells for complete, audited held-out comparisons.

paragraphs.en: The SDK parent solves 5.56% of tasks on the complete Terminal-Bench 2.0 TRAIN population. Its 1,728 physical actor requests use 4660.71 input/task (k) and 23.72 output/task (k), totaling 4684.42 Tokens/task (k). The study uses the shared backbone, the frozen 18/18/53 partition and common coding-completion prompt v2. All 18 outcomes have original benchmark scoring receipts; independent scoring recovery retains the paid actor work and original CPU and time limits. Every physical actor request is counted once, including unsuccessful tasks, and the complete cost has no unknown calls.
paragraphs.zh: SDK 父体在完整的 Terminal-Bench 2.0 TRAIN 任务总体上解决了 5.56% 的任务。 其 1,728 次物理 actor 请求使用了每任务 4660.71 输入 (k) 和每任务 23.72 输出 (k)，合计每任务 4684.42 Token (k)。 该研究使用共享骨干网络、固定的 18/18/53 划分以及通用的代码补全提示词 v2。 全部 18 个结果均有原始基准评分凭证；独立评分恢复保留了已付费的 actor 工作以及原始 CPU 和时间限制。 每次物理 actor 请求均只计一次，包括未成功的任务，且总成本中不存在未知调用。

paragraphs.en: The parent falls below the required nine TRAIN successes, so validation and TEST remain sealed. Public TRAIN tool records contain 11 errors from using host directories in container calls and 70 repetitions of identical commands. These observations motivate a separately frozen shared-parent revision. Task-level benchmark verdicts, complete actor accounting and source hashes are bound in evidence/qwen_sdk_terminal_train18_native.json .
paragraphs.zh: 父分支低于所需的九次 TRAIN 成功，因此 validation 与 TEST 仍保持封存。 公开的 TRAIN 工具记录中包含 11 处在容器调用中使用宿主目录导致的错误，以及 70 次重复相同命令的情况。 这些观察结果促使我们单独冻结一个共享父分支的修订版本。 任务级基准判定结果、完整的 actor 记账信息以及源代码哈希值均绑定在 evidence/qwen_sdk_terminal_train18_native.json 中。

paragraphs.en: Each search makes two sparse-instruction proposals on all 32 training scenarios. The second receives the first candidate’s training feedback. A grouped cross-fitted router admits only positive supported advantage; protected validation selects among admitted candidates and the seed. Codex applies residual instructions through task-local AGENTS.md ; DeepSeek uses an additive system-prompt section. Original execution loops, tools, model and task limits stay fixed. Policy, adapter, scorer and source hashes freeze before testing; validation failures and test outcomes never enter the proposer.
paragraphs.zh: 每次搜索在全部 32 个训练场景上生成两个稀疏指令提案。 第二个提案会接收第一个候选的训练反馈。 分组交叉拟合的路由器只接受正的支持优势；受保护的验证集在已接受的候选与种子之间进行选择。 Codex 通过任务本地的 AGENTS.md 应用残差指令；DeepSeek 使用附加式的系统提示部分。 原始执行循环、工具、模型与任务限制保持固定。 策略、适配器、评分器与源哈希在测试前冻结；验证失败与测试结果绝不进入提案者。

paragraphs.en: Both searches reject their two candidates and retain the seed. paragraphs.en: The completion audit verifies all 576 DeepSeek benchmark outcomes and reconciles actor and judge attempts across continuations. The source bindings retain all 1,152 test observations, frozen policies, proposal-feedback lineage, execution-record hashes and unknown-cost records. The separate held-out coding protocol uses an 18/18/53 task split and five test repetitions, scored by the official Harbor binary verifier. VQAv2 uses 43,265/42,925/128,164 questions grouped into 8,101/8,101/24,302 images, with official soft accuracy. The September 30 snapshot (10:22 UTC) records blocked Terminal and VQA continuations, not complete paired tests. Figure 3 uses only complete frozen TEST scores, with all success rates in percentages. The archived DeepSeek costs use the recorded-usage scope in Table 14 ; its Terminal-Bench protocol has no complete test comparison. Coding TRAIN and GAIA2 validation results, including rejected candidates, retain their original scopes in Appendix I and the archived development figures. The prospective coding protocol retains the complete validation-selected TEST comparison whether its quality–cost outcome is positive, null or negative. The 30% minimum and 40% target token reductions remain measured objectives. Complete TRAIN evaluations of all methods and original-harness capability precede protected evaluation; validation selects TRAIN-frozen instructions by benchmark performance, then complete actor cost, without supplying optimizer feedback.
paragraphs.zh: 完成度审计核验了全部 576 项 DeepSeek 基准结果，并对跨续接的执行方与评判方尝试进行了对账。 源绑定保留了全部 1,152 条测试观测、冻结策略、提案—反馈谱系、执行记录哈希以及未知成本记录。 单独的保留集编码协议采用 18/18/53 的任务划分和五次测试重复，由官方 Harbor 二进制校验器评分。 VQAv2 使用按 8,101/8,101/24,302 张图像分组的 43,265/42,925/128,164 个问题，并采用官方软准确率。 9 月 30 日的快照（UTC 时间 10:22）记录了被阻断的 Terminal 与 VQA 续接，而非完整的配对测试。 图 3 仅使用完整的冻结 TEST 分数，所有成功率均以百分比表示。 归档的 DeepSeek 成本采用表 14 中的记录用量口径；其 Terminal-Bench 协议没有完整的测试对比。 编码 TRAIN 与 GAIA2 验证结果（包括被拒绝的候选）在附录 I 和归档的开发图表中保留其原始口径。 前瞻性编码协议保留完整的经验证筛选的 TEST 对比，无论其质量—成本结果是正面、中性还是负面。 30% 的最低与 40% 的目标 token 缩减仍是既定的衡量目标。 对所有方法与原始测试框架能力的完整 TRAIN 评估先于受保护评估进行；验证环节按基准表现、随后按完整的执行方成本来筛选 TRAIN 冻结指令，且不向优化器提供反馈。

paragraphs.en: The comparison evaluates all 96 TEST scenarios with registered seeds 20260928, 20260929 and 20260930. Validation retained the empty original-harness policy before TEST; both arms apply zero residual edits. Original harness: 52.43% success and 648.71 actor input-plus-output Tokens/task (k). Retained selection: 52.78% success and 708.73 actor input-plus-output Tokens/task (k). All failed actor execution costs are included; evaluator costs and TRAIN bank-search costs are recorded separately. This retained selection is reported under the pre-registered all-outcomes rule. paragraphs.en: The DeepSeek Harness evaluations cover all 18 Terminal-Bench 2.0 TRAIN tasks. The original harness, CoT-only and CoT/Jev achieve 55.56%, 66.67% and 72.22% success, respectively. Their selected executions consume 1586.15, 1993.35 and 2067.93 Tokens/task (k), including failed tasks. The CoT/Jev arm improves TRAIN success but uses 30.37% more tokens than the original harness and 3.74% more than CoT-only; the 40% saving target remains unmet. SAM’s original actor is scored by an executed benchmark verifier with no new actor calls (eight tests pass, one fails). A separate interrupted historical call still lacks provider usage; its known costs and unknown remainder are retained outside these selected execution totals. The repaired arms share the frozen original prompt and CoT/Jev adapter bytes. These are TRAIN records under the fixed 18/18/53 split. The TRAIN-frozen candidate proceeds through all 18 validation tasks before selection and a pre-TEST source freeze. Paired TEST evaluates all 53 tasks once per arm, using the first registered execution seed 2026092801; this archived protocol has no complete paired test set (53 tasks) result. Complete TEST comparisons are reported regardless of the sign of the measured effect. A separate slow-CoT-authored revision batches determined shell commands and declares guarded literal action banks. CoT-only and CoT/Jev evaluate the same revised instruction on all 18 TRAIN tasks; the original harness is unchanged. The new author call costs 5.81 Tokens/task (k), accounted separately from task execution.
paragraphs.zh: DeepSeek Harness 评估覆盖全部 18 个 Terminal-Bench 2.0 TRAIN 任务。 原始 harness、仅 CoT 和 CoT/Jev 分别取得 55.56%、66.67% 和 72.22% 的成功率。 其选定的执行消耗 1586.15、1993.35 和 2067.93 Tokens/task（k），包含失败任务。 CoT/Jev 分支提升了 TRAIN 成功率，但比原始 harness 多用 30.37% 的 tokens，比仅 CoT 多用 3.74%；40% 的节省目标仍未达成。 SAM 的原始 actor 由执行的基准验证器评分，无需新的 actor 调用（八项测试通过，一项失败）。 另一次被中断的历史调用仍缺少提供商用量数据；其已知成本和未知剩余部分保留在这些选定执行总量之外。 修复后的各分支共享冻结的原始提示词和 CoT/Jev 适配器字节。 这些是固定 18/18/53 划分下的 TRAIN 记录。 TRAIN 冻结的候选在选定和 TEST 前源码冻结之前，需通过全部 18 个验证任务。 成对 TEST 对每个分支各评估一次全部 53 个任务，使用首个注册的执行种子 2026092801；该已归档协议没有完整的成对测试集（53 个任务）结果。 无论测得效应的正负如何，均报告完整的 TEST 对比。 一次单独的慢速 CoT 撰写的修订版本对确定的 shell 命令进行批处理，并声明受保护的字面动作库。 仅 CoT 和 CoT/Jev 在全部 18 个 TRAIN 任务上评估同一修订后的指令；原始 harness 保持不变。 新的撰写调用成本为 5.81 Tokens/task（k），与任务执行分开核算。

paragraphs.en: The public-admissibility DeepSeek-flash parent records a pre-repair 3.13% verdict across all 32 GAIA2-mini TRAIN scenarios. Its complete actor input-plus-output cost remains 637.86 Tokens/task (k) (637.86 Tokens/task (k) per scenario), including failures and all 401 provider calls; cached tokens are included in input tokens. The judge transport changed [[True]] to [[true]] , which the benchmark case-sensitive checker could not parse. All ten audited positive TRAIN sanity-check responses reproduce this failure. These verdicts are archived as scoring failure evidence and excluded from the parent-capability assessment. The Figure 2 runner preserves judge response text. New source-frozen industrial runs adopt that transport contract, a 7260-second supervisor timeout and environment-driven continuation when user-turn counts are unspecified. Benchmark scenario durations, judge prompts and validation rules remain unchanged. The fixed 32/32/96 partition and complete actor accounting are retained. The complete DeepSeek Harness test set (96 tasks) comparison is reported above; the corrected Codex comparison continues.
paragraphs.zh: 公开可用性 DeepSeek-flash 母记录在全部 32 个 GAIA2-mini TRAIN 场景中记录了修复前 3.13% 的判定结果。 其完整的智能体输入加输出成本仍为每任务 637.86 Tokens (k)（每个场景 637.86 Tokens (k)），包括失败情况和全部 401 次提供商调用；缓存 token 计入输入 token。 评判器传输将 [[True]] 改为 [[true]]，基准测试的大小写敏感检查器无法解析该内容。 全部十个经审计的正向 TRAIN 合理性检查响应均复现此失败。 这些判定结果被归档为评分失败证据，并从母能力评估中排除。 图 2 的运行器保留了评判器响应文本。 新的源冻结工业运行采用该传输契约、7260 秒的监督器超时，以及当用户轮次数未指定时的环境驱动式继续机制。 基准测试场景时长、评判器提示词和验证规则保持不变。 固定的 32/32/96 划分和完整的智能体核算予以保留。 完整的 DeepSeek Harness 测试集（96 个任务）对比已在上文报告；修正后的 Codex 对比继续进行。

paragraphs.en: The complete coding training set (18 tasks) has 577 original-harness, 624 CoT-only and 670 CoT/Jev SDK stream requests. The 21 audited fast tool executions replace 3.13% of CoT/Jev stream requests, leaving 649 slow requests; 642 requests have no complete eligible candidate state. All 28 fast requests, including seven fallbacks, consume 4.91 of 2067.93 Tokens/task (k) (0.24%). The mechanism profiler reads only frozen TRAIN actor receipts and makes no model or evaluator calls. Its counts explain the coverage revision: useful guarded action chains must replace substantially more slow requests for a large complete-task saving. A new source-bound original SDK check verifies fast execution, the CoT-only baseline, explicit abstention, and slow–fast–slow resumption, including exact preservation of valid empty reasoning blocks. All setup attempts, including failed checks, have their acquisition expenditure recorded externally and remain separate from benchmark execution; the checks make zero benchmark calls. The next prospective revision uses one slow-CoT author after the preceding TRAIN population has complete benchmark verdicts, then evaluates identical frozen instructions in CoT-only and CoT/Jev on all 18 TRAIN tasks. Its single-encoding fast state retains decoded public values once and keeps original slow-reasoning history intact. This archived prospective protocol is distinct from the complete comparisons reported in Appendix L .
paragraphs.zh: 完整的编码训练集（18 个任务）包含 577 个原始框架（original-harness）请求、624 个仅思维链（CoT-only）请求和 670 个 CoT/Jev SDK 流式请求。 经审计的 21 次快速工具执行替换了 3.13% 的 CoT/Jev 流式请求，剩下 649 个慢速请求；其中 642 个请求没有完整且符合条件的候选状态。 全部 28 个快速请求（包括 7 次回退）共消耗 2067.93 Tokens/task (k) 中的 4.91（0.24%）。 该机制分析器只读取冻结的 TRAIN 智能体回执，不调用任何模型或评估器。 其统计结果解释了覆盖率的修订：受保护的有效动作链必须替换多得多的慢速请求，才能带来大幅的完整任务节省。 一项新的绑定来源的原始 SDK 检查用于验证快速执行、仅思维链基线、明确弃权，以及慢—快—慢的恢复过程，包括对有效空推理块的精确保留。 所有设置尝试（包括未通过的检查）的获取开销均在外部记录，并与基准测试执行保持分离；这些检查对基准测试的调用次数为零。 下一次前瞻性修订在先前的 TRAIN 群体获得完整的基准判定后，使用一位慢速思维链作者，然后在全部 18 个 TRAIN 任务上评估相同的冻结指令在 CoT-only 与 CoT/Jev 下的表现。 其单一编码的快速状态只对解码后的公共值保留一次，并完整保留原始的慢速推理历史。 该归档的前瞻性协议不同于附录 L 中报告的完整比较。

AIME uses 186 training questions, 186 validation questions and 560 test questions, with one final execution per question and method. Training supplies method updates; validation selects frozen candidates; the selected policies are frozen before testing. AIME SkillOpt uses three completed optimization rounds, and AutoSaddler uses four. All methods share Qwen3.8-27B, the fixed seed, native integer scorer, single-sequence inference and 32,768-token output capacity. Costs include all actor input and output, fast decisions, slow fallbacks and unsuccessful executions. HarnessMM’s shared author cost is charged once across the full test population. Optimizer and other training costs are retained separately from test execution cost.

paragraphs.en: GAIA2 uses 160 training scenarios, 160 validation scenarios and 480 test scenarios. Each test scenario is executed once per method using the first registered seed. SkillOpt and AutoSaddler use one complete official optimization round, followed by protected validation and a frozen selection. All four methods share Qwen3.8-27B, native scoring, a 4,096-token output capacity and a 7,260-second scenario timeout. Actor cost includes all reasoning, fast decisions, control, fallback and unsuccessful calls; native judge costs are recorded separately. Online bank authorship is included in actor execution. Training and optimization costs retain their separate scope.
paragraphs.zh: GAIA2 使用 160 个训练场景、160 个验证场景和 480 个测试场景。 每个测试场景使用首个注册的种子对每种方法执行一次。 SkillOpt 和 AutoSaddler 使用一轮完整的官方优化，随后进行受保护的验证和冻结选择。 四种方法均共享 Qwen3.8-27B、原生评分、4,096 个 token 的输出容量以及 7,260 秒的场景超时时间。 智能体的成本包括所有推理、快速决策、控制、回退和失败的调用；原生评判器的成本单独记录。 在线银行编写成本包含在智能体执行成本中。 训练和优化成本保持其各自独立的范围。

paragraphs.en: Across the complete GAIA2 comparison, HarnessMM performs 146 verified fast executions among 10,424 native action attempts (1.40%). Each counted execution links the selector’s physical one-token response to the exact native action arguments and tool observation, and omits the slow reasoning callback. The denominator includes unsuccessful and unverified action attempts. Table 16 reports the complete actor input and output components. HarnessMM uses 636.28 input and 3.36 output Tokens/task (k); input accounts for 99.47% of its actor cost. The integrated harness reduces complete actor cost by 12.41% relative to No Skill. This comparison measures the combined harness; it does not isolate the contribution of fast execution from context compression.
paragraphs.zh: 在完整的 GAIA2 对比中，HarnessMM 在 10,424 次原生动作尝试中执行了 146 次经过验证的快速执行（1.40%）。 每次统计的执行都将选择器的物理单 Token 响应与确切的原生动作参数和工具观测关联起来，并省略慢速推理回调。 分母包含未成功和未经验证的动作尝试。 表 16 报告了完整的执行体输入与输出组成部分。 HarnessMM 使用 636.28 输入和 3.36 输出 Tokens/task (k)；输入占其执行体成本的 99.47%。 相较于 No Skill，集成框架将完整执行体成本降低了 12.41%。 这一对比衡量的是组合框架；它并未将快速执行的贡献与上下文压缩的贡献分离开来。

paragraphs.en: The frozen six-card program bank preserves 100.00% TRAIN correctness at 4.68 Tokens/task (k): five model-based one-token judges consume 0.89 Tokens/task (k) and three original-harness fallbacks contribute 3.79 Tokens/task (k), normalized over all six tasks. The two offline CoT author calls consume 21.98 Tokens/task (k) separately. The complete validation comparison preserves its benchmark quality floor but misses the earlier cost targets. Under the October 6 all-outcomes reporting instruction, the same bank proceeds to the fixed test set (18 tasks) without further method updates. Training improvements and the complete validation result retain their actual phases; no TEST result is used for selection or revision.
paragraphs.zh: 冻结的六卡程序库在 4.68 Tokens/task (k) 的开销下保持了 100.00% 的 TRAIN 正确率：五个基于模型的单 Token 判定消耗 0.89 Tokens/task (k)，三个原始测试框架回退贡献 3.79 Tokens/task (k)，按全部六个任务归一化。 两次离线 CoT 撰写调用分别消耗 21.98 Tokens/task (k)。 完整的验证对比保住了其基准质量底线，但未达到此前的成本目标。 在 10 月 6 日的全结果报告指令下，同一个程序库在不再进行方法更新的情况下进入固定测试集（18 个任务）。 训练改进与完整验证结果保留其实际阶段；没有任何 TEST 结果被用于选择或修订。

paragraphs.en: Exact-union packing merges overlapping source windows without changing characters or order, then refills the budget using the frozen 256-question TRAIN ranker and target-role contract. Union 704 leads the family at 76.23% EM, saving 61.82% of incumbent tokens and 28.58% against No Skill. It recovers 30 of 58 net lost answers, leaving a 0.825-point EM gap. A 1,000-resample question/context-group bootstrap gives an EM-difference interval of [ − 1.89 , + 0.21 ] [-1.89,+0.21] points and token-ratio interval [ 0.374 , 0.389 ] [0.374,0.389] against the incumbent. These TRAIN intervals do not establish noninferiority; the exact-union family did not advance to validation or TEST. None of 25 earlier five-fold/penalty recovery fits recovers all 2,616 answers within 0.98 Tokens/task (k). Those estimates reuse recorded outcomes and costs without new actor calls.
paragraphs.zh: 精确并集打包在不改变字符或顺序的前提下合并重叠的源窗口，然后使用冻结的 256 题训练（TRAIN）排序器与目标角色契约重新填满预算。 并集 704 在该系列中以 76.23% 的 EM 领先，相比现有方法节省 61.82% 的 token，相比 No Skill 节省 28.58%。 它恢复了 58 个净损失答案中的 30 个，留下 0.825 分的 EM 差距。 基于 1,000 次重抽样的问题/上下文组自助法给出相对现有方法的 EM 差值区间 [ − 1.89 , + 0.21 ] [-1.89,+0.21] 分以及 token 比值区间 [ 0.374 , 0.389 ] [0.374,0.389]。 这些训练（TRAIN）区间并不能确立非劣效性；精确并集系列未进入验证集或测试集（TEST）。 在此前 25 次五折/惩罚恢复拟合中，没有一次能在每任务 0.98 个 token（k）内恢复全部 2,616 个答案。 这些估计复用已记录的结果与成本，不进行新的智能体调用。

paragraphs.en: The selected GAIA2 incumbent improves validation and saves 11.18% of actor tokens. The respective 2.72 and 3.94 judge Tokens/task (k) give 11.00% combined saving. Token-wire v3 loses quality and increases actor cost by 37.08%, with 2.15 separate judge Tokens/task (k) and no unknown usage or context rejections. Lazy schemas lose quality at 10.82% higher actor cost. Exact ledger references preserve all 24 paired outcomes with 17.02% fewer actor tokens. References to unchanged tool actions/observations replace duplicated receipts; task and tool contracts remain intact. Parent/candidate use 472/474 paid actor calls and 124,328/120,968 judge tokens.
paragraphs.zh: 选定的GAIA2现任方案提升了验证效果，并节省了11.18%的智能体token。 分别为2.72和3.94的评判Tokens/task (k) 带来合计11.00%的节省。 Token-wire v3质量下降，且智能体成本增加37.08%，其单独的评判Tokens/task (k) 为2.15，且没有未知用法或上下文拒绝。 惰性模式（lazy schemas）质量下降，智能体成本增加10.82%。 精确账本引用保留了全部24个成对结果，智能体token减少17.02%。 对未变化的工具动作/观测使用引用来替代重复的回执；任务和工具契约保持不变。 父方案/候选方案分别使用472/474次付费智能体调用和124,328/120,968个评判token。

paragraphs.en: On all 32 TRAIN scenarios (Table 19 ), official SoL-Pi [ 23 ] saves 71.42–71.45% of Pi’s actor tokens with 33.33% versus 20.83% success. It gains five successes over No Harness at 2.928–2.930 times the cost. Historical HarnessMM exact references reach 43.75%, saving 36.07% against their parent, 22.15% against No Harness and 73.41–73.43% against this SoL-Pi adapter. This is separate from the CoT/Jev core: its earlier candidate scores 37.50% versus 50.00%, saves 5.29%, and defers all 276 typed decisions. The 50% No Harness saving target remains unmet.

paragraphs.en: We adapt AutoSOTA’s baseline, diagnosis, prospective revision and independent evaluation workflow [ 39 ] ; the official AutoSOTA CLI is not invoked. TRAIN fits an answer-support ranker and a risk score from public source, draft and model-reported token-probability features. Greedy source packing supplies the short answer request. The frozen risk policy assigns incumbent recovery to 220 of 3,395 questions; every initial draft and paid recovery is counted. The 6.48% recovery fraction and all model, scorer and policy hashes are fixed before validation. Validation exposes aggregate selection statistics only; no case, answer or failure trajectory enters training. Official SkillOpt and AutoSaddler receive configured pools of 2,716 optimization and 679 internal-selection questions within TRAIN. Actual distinct optimizer exposure is 3,395 questions for SkillOpt and 711 for AutoSaddler; each selected-policy TRAIN and validation evaluation covers all 3,395 questions in its split. The complete TRAIN comparison passes the all-method candidate-admission gate (Table 21 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿用 AutoSOTA 的基线、诊断、前瞻性修订和独立评估流程 [39]；但不调用官方的 AutoSOTA 命令行界面。 TRAIN 基于公开来源、草稿以及模型报告的词元概率特征，拟合一个答案支持排序器和一个风险分数。 贪心来源打包用于提供简短答案请求。 冻结的风险策略将现任恢复分配给 3,395 个问题中的 220 个；每个初始草稿和付费恢复都被计入。 6.48% 的恢复比例以及所有模型、评分器和策略哈希在验证之前均已固定。 验证只暴露聚合选择统计信息；没有任何案例、答案或失败轨迹进入训练。 官方的 SkillOpt 和 AutoSaddler 在 TRAIN 内接收配置好的 2,716 个优化问题和 679 个内部选择问题池。 优化器的实际独立暴露为 SkillOpt 3,395 个问题、AutoSaddler 711 个问题；每次所选策略的 TRAIN 和验证评估都覆盖其划分中的全部 3,395 个问题。 完整的 TRAIN 比较通过了全方法候选准入门槛（表 21）。

paragraphs.en: On complete validation, risk-220 uses 0.99 Tokens/task (k) at 76.76% EM and 83.36% F1. No Skill uses 1.23 Tokens/task (k) at 69.81% EM. The token reduction is 19.08% (paired 95% interval [ 16.57 , 21.23 ] [16.57,21.23] %), with a 6.951-point EM gain (paired 95% interval [ 5.685 , 8.277 ] [5.685,8.277] points). Risk-220 saves 38.57% against SkillOpt while improving EM by 4.624 points, and saves 20.75% against AutoSaddler with 7.158 points higher EM. paragraphs.en: The archived stall-gated traces illustrate both progress and failure. In the heating example, the controller picks up egg 3 at step 13, heats it at 15, and places it in the fridge at 17. Heating feedback updates the tracked state, excluding the otherwise legal cooling action. The episode succeeds in 18 steps with seven model calls and 8.17 Tokens/task (k) for that single episode. In the two-book example, the placement ledger distinguishes the first completed book from the remaining target; the run succeeds in 22 steps with 11 calls and 9.96 Tokens/task (k). In the heated-cup failure, supported exploration reaches the still-closed fridge at the final allowed step, 48, without finding and heating the cup. Local support does not guarantee timely task completion. paragraphs.en: The separate studies with the same backbone also fail their quality targets. Model-based typed checks reach 72.12 EM at 4.08 Tokens/task (k) versus 73.32 at 3.00 Tokens/task (k) for original HarnessMM, falling back on 87.80% of tasks. Probability-only full/compact source selection reaches 44.16/45.06 EM. Adding 96 CoT tokens gives 29.00 versus 27.06 for its fresh zero-CoT control; restoring a short evidence sentence gives 35.10 versus 19.98 for its label-alias control. The initial evidence-generation attempt was inactive and scored 20.10. Source-rule typed recovery reaches 69.72 versus 72.08 for fresh original HarnessMM, saving only 10.50% against its 30% target. Each study retains its own model, request template, complete controls and accounting in the source bundle; none replaces the later full-source result.
paragraphs.zh: 使用相同骨干网络（backbone）的独立研究同样未能达到其质量目标。 基于模型的类型化检查在 4.08 Tokens/task (k) 下达到 72.12 EM，而原始 HarnessMM 在 3.00 Tokens/task (k) 下达到 73.32 EM，并在 87.80% 的任务上回退。 仅使用概率的完整/精简来源选择分别达到 44.16/45.06 EM。 增加 96 个 CoT token 得到 29.00，而其全新的零 CoT 对照为 27.06；恢复一句简短证据得到 35.10，而其标签别名对照为 19.98。 最初的证据生成尝试处于无效状态，得分为 20.10。 来源规则类型化恢复达到 69.72，而全新原始 HarnessMM 为 72.08，仅节省 10.50%，未达到其 30% 的目标。 每项研究在来源包中都保留其自己的模型、请求模板、完整对照和核算；没有任何一项会替代后来的完整来源结果。

paragraphs.en: Spreadsheet’s opened LOGO267 replay gives 4.12% at 48.36 Tokens/task (k) for archived No Skill, 3.00% at 51.58 Tokens/task (k) for SkillOpt, 2.25% at 47.77 Tokens/task (k) for AutoSaddler, and 3.00% at 11.78 Tokens/task (k) for HarnessMM. The last three use fresh executions; HarnessMM retains 170 repair/abstention routes and 97 No-Skill routes chosen post hoc by workbook group. Its separate seven-condition test on 200 opened tasks gives deterministic recovery 2.50%, matching original HarnessMM at 25.06% lower cost, but below No Skill and AutoSaddler at 3.50%. Its 97-task state-controller study solves 0.00% versus the parent’s 1.03% while increasing cost. The earlier Terminal-Bench subset gives HarnessMM 8.33% versus 25.00% for each baseline; the visual-web subset gives 25.00% versus 33.33% for No Skill and SkillOpt.
paragraphs.zh: 电子表格中已打开的 LOGO267 复现结果为：存档的 No Skill 达到 4.12%，Tokens/task (k) 为 48.36；SkillOpt 达到 3.00%，Tokens/task (k) 为 51.58；AutoSaddler 达到 2.25%，Tokens/task (k) 为 47.77；HarnessMM 达到 3.00%，Tokens/task (k) 为 11.78。 后三者使用全新执行；HarnessMM 保留了 170 条修复/弃答路径以及 97 条由工作簿组事后选出的 No-Skill 路径。 其在 200 个已打开任务上进行的独立七条件测试给出 2.50% 的确定性恢复率，与原版 HarnessMM 相当且成本低 25.06%，但低于 No Skill 和 AutoSaddler 的 3.50%。 其 97 任务状态控制器研究解决率为 0.00%，而父方法为 1.03%，且成本更高。 早前的 Terminal-Bench 子集中，HarnessMM 为 8.33%，而每个基线均为 25.00%；视觉网页子集中为 25.00%，而 No Skill 和 SkillOpt 均为 33.33%。

paragraphs.en: The five-module response study evaluates all 32 masks, ten equal-length body controls and Original A/A on 256 discovery tasks and 257 held-out-stage tasks in 256 source groups. The full harness solves 84.82%; the discovery-selected normalization/answer-type mask solves 84.44% at 23.91% lower cost. No module passes the primary familywise criterion, and no average main effect or pair interaction passes the Holm-corrected secondary tests. Nineteen tasks vary in EM across masks; the outcome-selected oracle reaches 86.77% and is not a deployable selector.
paragraphs.zh: 五模块响应研究在256个源分组上，对全部32种掩码、十个等长正文对照以及原始A/A，在256个发现任务和257个留出阶段任务上进行了评估。 完整测试框架解决率为84.82%；由发现阶段选出的规范化/答案类型掩码解决率为84.44%，成本降低23.91%。 没有任何模块通过主要的族错误率标准，也没有任何平均主效应或成对交互作用通过经Holm校正的次要检验。 十九个任务在不同掩码下的精确匹配结果存在差异；由结果选出的理想上限达到86.77%，但并非可部署的选择器。

paragraphs.en: The targeted replication retains those 19 tasks, two F1-only cases and 32 stable controls, with six arms in eight blocks (four serial, four 16-concurrent). Eighteen of the 19 EM effects retain their mean direction, and 17 retain a nonzero sign in every block; both F1-only effects persist. Stable controls have zero EM edge effects, while Original A/A changes EM on two variable tasks. These are conditional, outcome-selected effects; 13 of the 19 nominated modules concern normalization. All retained module bytes, ordering and answer contracts are unchanged, and generic/unrelated controls exactly match complete model input token counts.
paragraphs.zh: 针对性复现保留了那 19 个任务、两个仅 F1 的案例和 32 个稳定对照，在八个区块中设六个分支（四个串行、四个 16 并发）。 19 个 EM 效应中有 18 个保持其均值方向，17 个在所有区块中均保持非零符号；两个仅 F1 的效应均持续存在。 稳定对照的 EM 边缘效应为零，而 Original A/A 在两个变量任务上改变了 EM。 这些是有条件的、按结果筛选出的效应；19 个被提名的模块中有 13 个涉及归一化。 所有保留模块的字节、顺序和答案契约均未改变，且通用/无关对照与完整模型输入 token 数完全匹配。

paragraphs.en: The GQA pilot evaluates 40 balanced questions in 19 image groups, plus 88 entailment-support questions, with three repeats. True-image accuracy is 62.50% for the base and 65.00% for both grounding and generic instructions of equal token length; shuffled-image accuracy is 35.00%, 33.33% and 35.00%, respectively. Grounding and generic correctness coincide on every balanced task. Their true-minus-shuffled interaction is 1.67 points, with a descriptive image-cluster interval of [ − 2.44 , 7.69 ] [-2.44,7.69] . Images use 448-by-448 padded renderings with 196 model image tokens. The 2,304 benchmark requests consume 0.27 Tokens/task (k); admission adds 500. Model image tokens and the unchanged publisher scorer were replayed independently [ 14 ] .
paragraphs.zh: GQA 试点在 19 个图像组中评估 40 道平衡题目，外加 88 道蕴含支持题，重复三次。 真实图像准确率方面，基础指令为 62.50%，token 长度相同的接地指令和通用指令均为 65.00%；打乱图像准确率分别为 35.00%、33.33% 和 35.00%。 在每道平衡任务上，接地指令与通用指令的正确性完全一致。 二者“真实减打乱”的交互差异为 1.67 分，描述性图像簇区间为 [ − 2.44 , 7.69 ] [-2.44,7.69]。 图像使用 448×448 的填充渲染，对应 196 个模型图像 token。 2,304 个基准请求消耗 0.27 Tokens/task (k)；准入额外增加 500。 模型图像 token 与未更改的发布方评分器被独立重放 [ 14 ]。

paragraphs.en: Two later feasibility studies also stop before final evaluation. Text calibration evaluates 512 groups over three repeats after training on 2,048 groups; all four adaptive thresholds fail the joint gate. The least restrictive saves 4.3734% while lowering EM and F1; the quality-preserving three-short-route policy saves only 0.1483%. For the MMMU instruction library, 270 calls on 90 training questions consume 0.65 Tokens/task (k), including 0.51 input-image/task (k). Even zero output permits only 0.366% saving, below the 10% target. This is a cost-feasibility bound; task accuracy was not measured. The completed gate records remain in generated/token_efficiency_protocol.tex ; unexecuted plans are omitted from the paper.
paragraphs.zh: 后续两项可行性研究也都在最终评估之前中止。 文本校准在 2,048 组上训练后，对 512 组进行三次重复评估；所有四个自适应阈值均未通过联合门控。 限制最少的策略节省 4.3734%，但降低了 EM 和 F1；保持质量的“三条短路径”策略仅节省 0.1483%。 对于 MMMU 指令库，对 90 个训练问题的 270 次调用消耗 0.65 Tokens/task (k)，其中 0.51 为 input-image/task (k)。 即使输出为零，也只能节省 0.366%，低于 10% 的目标。 这是一个成本可行性上界；任务准确率未经测量。 已完成的门控记录保留在 generated/token_efficiency_protocol.tex 中；未执行的计划不在论文中列出。

paragraphs.en: Token totals include all input/output, truncations and fallback. Search, rejected proposals, validation, judges and shared acquisition are separate; inherited calls are charged once. Finite break-even requires measured development cost and positive per-task savings. Unknown historical costs stay unknown. Runs have no cumulative token stop; model capacities and benchmark task limits remain. In the paper directory, bash build.sh renders and compiles saved results without model or benchmark calls; template-dependency.json pins the CVPR and bibliography styles.
paragraphs.zh: Token 总量包括所有输入/输出、截断与回退。 搜索、被否决的提案、验证、评审与共享获取单独计费；继承的调用只计费一次。 有限的盈亏平衡需要可测量的开发成本和每任务的正节省。 未知的的历史成本保持未知。 运行没有累计 token 停止条件；模型容量与基准任务上限仍然有效。 在论文目录中，bash build.sh 可在不调用模型或基准的情况下渲染并编译已保存的结果；template-dependency.json 固定了 CVPR 与参考文献样式。

paragraphs.en: Panel (c) uses MBPP-sanitized’s complete 427-task release with the custom 85/85/257 partition, seed 20261005. The DeepSeek Harness pair reports all 257 TEST tasks; the independent Codex pair completes all 257 TEST tasks at 236/257 and 233/257 successes (91.83% and 90.66%). Both harness pairs use the same fixed backbone. Actors receive the released public assertions and common instructions, with a 300-second actor deadline and 30-second verifier deadline. Reference implementations are excluded from actor workspaces.
paragraphs.zh: 面板 (c) 使用 MBPP-sanitized 的完整 427 任务版本，并采用自定义的 85/85/257 划分，随机种子为 20261005。 DeepSeek Harness 对报告了全部 257 个 TEST 任务；独立的 Codex 对在全部 257 个 TEST 任务上分别取得 236/257 和 233/257 的成功（91.83% 和 90.66%）。 两组 harness 均使用同一个固定主干模型。 智能体接收已发布的公开断言和通用指令，智能体时限为 300 秒，验证器时限为 30 秒。 参考实现被排除在智能体的工作空间之外。

paragraphs.en: These historical training set (85 tasks) comparisons provide development evidence for the compound action bank and structured literal bank. The DeepSeek condition records 153 certified substitutions and 62 public-guard confirmations. TRAIN develops candidates, validation selects only TRAIN-frozen configurations, and TEST evaluates the selected configuration without further revision.
paragraphs.zh: 这些历史训练集（85个任务）的对比为复合动作库和结构化字面库提供了开发依据。 DeepSeek 条件记录了153个经认证的替换和62个公共防护确认。 TRAIN 用于开发候选方案，验证环节仅选择 TRAIN 冻结的配置，TEST 则对所选配置进行评估且不再进一步修改。

sents.zh: DeepSeek 条件记录了153个经认证的替换和62个公共防护确认。

paragraphs.en: Panel (d) uses the complete 164-task HumanEval release, custom 33/33/98 partition, seed 20261006, and one attempt per task. All four methods use the same fixed backbone. Actors receive the function signature, specification and docstring examples; reference solutions and verifier tests are excluded from their context. The Harbor adapter evaluates released functional tests with the common 300-second actor and 30-second verifier deadlines. Each capable TRAIN parent and its candidate precede protected validation and selection freeze.
paragraphs.zh: 面板（d）使用完整的 164 个任务的 HumanEval 发布版、自定义的 33/33/98 划分、种子 20261006，以及每个任务一次尝试。 所有四种方法都使用同一个固定主干。 智能体接收函数签名、规格说明和 docstring 示例；参考解答和验证测试不包含在其上下文中。 Harbor 适配器使用统一的 300 秒智能体时限和 30 秒验证时限来评估已发布的功能测试。 每个有能力的 TRAIN 父体及其候选体先于受保护的验证和选择冻结。

paragraphs.en: The complete HumanEval test set (98 tasks) Codex pair preserves 90.82% success at 66.72 versus 47.02 Tokens/task (k), a 29.54% reduction. The DeepSeek Harness pair improves from 71.43% to 85.71% at 96.28 versus 11.62 Tokens/task (k), an 87.93% reduction.
paragraphs.zh: 完整的 HumanEval 测试集（98 个任务）上，Codex 配对在 66.72 对 47.02 Tokens/task (k) 的情况下保持了 90.82% 的成功率，降低了 29.54%。 DeepSeek Harness 配对在 96.28 对 11.62 Tokens/task (k) 的情况下从 71.43% 提升到 85.71%，降低了 87.93%。

sents.en: The complete HumanEval test set (98 tasks) Codex pair preserves 90.82% success at 66.72 versus 47.02 Tokens/task (k), a 29.54% reduction.
sents.zh: 完整的 HumanEval 测试集（98 个任务）上，Codex 配对在 66.72 对 47.02 Tokens/task (k) 的情况下保持了 90.82% 的成功率，降低了 29.54%。

sents.en: The DeepSeek Harness pair improves from 71.43% to 85.71% at 96.28 versus 11.62 Tokens/task (k), an 87.93% reduction.

paragraphs.en: Panel (e) uses MiMo-v2.6-pro through the official DeepSeek Harness SDK Anthropic-compatible interface. The same 33/33/98 HumanEval partition, prompts, tools, scorer and one-attempt policy apply to both arms. The capable TRAIN parent reaches 96.97%, its frozen candidate reaches 100.00%, and both validation arms reach 96.97% before selection. Complete test set (98 tasks) success is 96.94% versus 97.96%, at 11.62 versus 4.40 Tokens/task (k), a 62.12% reduction. The MiMo Codex pair completes test set (98 tasks) at 93.88% versus 94.90% success; its costs are 62.60 versus 10.09 Tokens/task (k). The MiMo Codex MBPP comparison completes test set (257 tasks) at 248/257 baseline and 250/257 HarnessMM successes (96.50% and 97.28%), with 47.56 versus 11.00 Tokens/task (k). Panel (f) also reports the complete MiMo DeepSeek Harness test set (257 tasks) comparison: 251/257 versus 252/257 successes (97.67% and 98.05%), at 6.20 versus 5.11 Tokens/task (k). The concise literal-source author retains the structured action-bank schema and native tool interface; CPU receipt guards execute 480 certified substitutions. The custom 85/85/257 partition and seed 20261005 remain fixed. TRAIN develops the candidate, protected validation selects it, and source and selection freeze before TEST.
paragraphs.zh: 面板 (e) 通过官方 DeepSeek Harness SDK 的 Anthropic 兼容接口使用 MiMo-v2.6-pro。 相同的 33/33/98 HumanEval 划分、提示词、工具、评分器以及单次尝试策略同时适用于两组。 能力较强的 TRAIN 父体达到 96.97%，其冻结的候选体达到 100.00%，两组验证体在选择前均达到 96.97%。 完整测试集（98 个任务）的成功率为 96.94% 对 97.96%，每任务成本为 11.62 对 4.40 Tokens/task (k)，降低了 62.12%。 MiMo Codex 这一对在完整测试集（98 个任务）上的成功率为 93.88% 对 94.90%；其成本为每任务 62.60 对 10.09 Tokens/task (k)。 MiMo Codex 的 MBPP 对比在完整测试集（257 个任务）上为基线 248/257、HarnessMM 250/257（96.50% 和 97.28%），每任务成本为 47.56 对 11.00 Tokens/task (k)。 面板 (f) 还报告了完整的 MiMo DeepSeek Harness 测试集（257 个任务）对比：251/257 对 252/257 的成功数（97.67% 和 98.05%），每任务成本为 6.20 对 5.11 Tokens/task (k)。 精简的字面源码作者保留了结构化动作库模式与原生工具接口；CPU 回执守卫执行了 480 处经认证的替换。 自定义的 85/85/257 划分与种子 20261005 保持固定。 TRAIN 培育候选体，受保护的验证对其进行选择，并在 TEST 前冻结源码与选择。

sents.zh: 相同的 33/33/98 HumanEval 划分、提示词、工具、评分器以及单次尝试策略同时适用于两组。

sents.en: The capable TRAIN parent reaches 96.97%, its frozen candidate reaches 100.00%, and both validation arms reach 96.97% before selection.
sents.zh: 能力较强的 TRAIN 父体达到 96.97%，其冻结的候选体达到 100.00%，两组验证体在选择前均达到 96.97%。

sents.en: Complete test set (98 tasks) success is 96.94% versus 97.96%, at 11.62 versus 4.40 Tokens/task (k), a 62.12% reduction.
sents.zh: 完整测试集（98 个任务）的成功率为 96.94% 对 97.96%，每任务成本为 11.62 对 4.40 Tokens/task (k)，降低了 62.12%。

sents.en: The MiMo Codex pair completes test set (98 tasks) at 93.88% versus 94.90% success; its costs are 62.60 versus 10.09 Tokens/task (k).
sents.zh: MiMo Codex 这一对在完整测试集（98 个任务）上的成功率为 93.88% 对 94.90%；其成本为每任务 62.60 对 10.09 Tokens/task (k)。

sents.en: The MiMo Codex MBPP comparison completes test set (257 tasks) at 248/257 baseline and 250/257 HarnessMM successes (96.50% and 97.28%), with 47.56 versus 11.00 Tokens/task (k).
sents.zh: MiMo Codex 的 MBPP 对比在完整测试集（257 个任务）上为基线 248/257、HarnessMM 250/257（96.50% 和 97.28%），每任务成本为 47.56 对 11.00 Tokens/task (k)。

sents.en: Panel (f) also reports the complete MiMo DeepSeek Harness test set (257 tasks) comparison: 251/257 versus 252/257 successes (97.67% and 98.05%), at 6.20 versus 5.11 Tokens/task (k).
sents.zh: 面板 (f) 还报告了完整的 MiMo DeepSeek Harness 测试集（257 个任务）对比：251/257 对 252/257 的成功数（97.67% 和 98.05%），每任务成本为 6.20 对 5.11 Tokens/task (k)。

sents.en: The concise literal-source author retains the structured action-bank schema and native tool interface; CPU receipt guards execute 480 certified substitutions.
sents.zh: 精简的字面源码作者保留了结构化动作库模式与原生工具接口；CPU 回执守卫执行了 480 处经认证的替换。

sents.en: The custom 85/85/257 partition and seed 20261005 remain fixed.
sents.zh: 自定义的 85/85/257 划分与种子 20261005 保持固定。

sents.en: TRAIN develops the candidate, protected validation selects it, and source and selection freeze before TEST.
sents.zh: TRAIN 培育候选体，受保护的验证对其进行选择，并在 TEST 前冻结源码与选择。

paragraphs.en: Actor costs are reported as input-plus-output tokens per task, divided by 1,000. Input and disjoint cache-input buckets are counted once.
paragraphs.zh: Actor 成本按每个任务的输入加输出 token 数统计，再除以 1,000。 输入与不相交的缓存输入分桶只计算一次。

sents.en: Actor costs are reported as input-plus-output tokens per task, divided by 1,000.
sents.zh: Actor 成本按每个任务的输入加输出 token 数统计，再除以 1,000。

sents.en: Input and disjoint cache-input buckets are counted once.
sents.zh: 输入与不相交的缓存输入分桶只计算一次。

paragraphs.en: Costs are normalized over all tasks in each comparison and include unsuccessful executions. Exact measurements and cost scopes remain in the reproduction artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 每次比较中的成本都在所有任务上归一化，并包含未成功的执行。 精确的测量结果和成本范围保留在复现工件中。

sents.en: Exact measurements and cost scopes remain in the reproduction artifacts.
sents.zh: 精确的测量结果和成本范围保留在复现工件中。

paragraphs.en: The earlier MiMo Codex candidate completes the same 257 test tasks at 94.55% success and 10.45 Tokens/task (k); the selected successor reaches 97.28% with 11.00 Tokens/task (k). Both use the same native task population and limits.
paragraphs.zh: 更早的 MiMo Codex 候选智能体在同样的 257 个测试任务上达到 94.55% 的成功率和 10.45 Tokens/task (k)；被选中的后续版本达到 97.28% 的成功率和 11.00 Tokens/task (k)。 两者使用相同的原生任务总体和限制。

sents.en: The earlier MiMo Codex candidate completes the same 257 test tasks at 94.55% success and 10.45 Tokens/task (k); the selected successor reaches 97.28% with 11.00 Tokens/task (k).
sents.zh: 更早的 MiMo Codex 候选智能体在同样的 257 个测试任务上达到 94.55% 的成功率和 10.45 Tokens/task (k)；被选中的后续版本达到 97.28% 的成功率和 11.00 Tokens/task (k)。

sents.en: Both use the same native task population and limits.
sents.zh: 两者使用相同的原生任务总体和限制。

paragraphs.en: The 427 MBPP-sanitized tasks use 85 TRAIN/85 validation/257 TEST, seed 20261005, and one attempt per task. Both actors receive all released assertions; reference solutions are excluded. Selection and source freeze before TEST. The official dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 and Harbor 0.18.0 MBPP adapter share the backbone, prompts, tools and 300-second actor/30-second verifier limits. Success is 90.27% for the baseline and 91.83% for HarnessMM. Input/output Tokens/task (k) are 50.40/3.58 (53.98 total) and 6.84/3.77 (10.61 total), respectively. Complete costs cover slow authors, fast decisions, finalizers, fallbacks and failed executions; development costs are separate. HarnessMM makes 472 certified substitutions. CoT-only reaches 93.39% success at 15.04 Tokens/task (k): 11.21 input and 3.84 output. Savings are 80.35% against the original harness and 29.46% against CoT-only. The 40% target against both baselines with quality preserved remains open. TEST never guides revisions.
paragraphs.zh: 427 个经清洗的 MBPP 任务采用 85 训练/85 验证/257 测试的划分，随机种子为 20261005，每个任务仅尝试一次。 两个智能体都接收所有已发布的断言；参考解答被排除在外。 在测试前完成选择并冻结数据来源。 官方 dsh-v0.2.0-rc.1 与 Harbor 0.18.0 的 MBPP 适配器共享相同的主干、提示词、工具以及 300 秒智能体/30 秒验证器的时限。 基线的成功率为 90.27%，HarnessMM 为 91.83%。 每任务的输入/输出 Token（千）分别为 50.40/3.58（总计 53.98）和 6.84/3.77（总计 10.61）。 完整成本涵盖慢速作者、快速决策、终结器、回退机制和失败执行；开发成本单独计算。 HarnessMM 进行了 472 次经认证的替换。 仅思维链方式达到 93.39% 的成功率，每任务 Token（千）为 15.04：输入 11.21，输出 3.84。 相较于原始智能体框架节省 80.35%，相较于仅思维链方式节省 29.46%。 在质量保持的前提下，相对两个基线均达到 40% 的节省目标仍未实现。 测试集从不用于指导修订。
